source:
A bomb infused with the Force to break
inanimate objects. Deals great damage to
walls and objects in a \c[60]5x5 tile\c[0] area.

原力引爆炸弹
无放射性物体。 给自己带来巨大损失
墙壁和物体 \c[60]5页:15 瓷砖\c[0] 区域。

source:
A fiendish bomb. Throw it and deal
\c[60]300 + Force x10\c[0] fire damage to a \c[60]5x5 tile\c[0] area.
It can ignite if you take fire damage.
translation:
邪恶的炸弹 扔出来,发牌
\c[60]300 + 力 x10\c[0] a. 火灾损害 \c[60]5页:15 瓷砖\c[0] 区域。

source:
A strange parchment that calls storm clouds.
Deals lighting dmg in a \c[60]5x5 tile\c[0] area.
It's power increases with your \c[61]Willpower\c[0].
translation:
一只奇怪的羊皮纸 叫做暴风雪
以 DMG 照明交易 \c[60]5页:15 瓷砖\c[0] 区域。
力量随你而增加 \c[61]意志力\c[0].

source:
A strange parchment that spits fire.
Deals fire damage straight ahead for \c[60]3 tiles\c[0].
It's power increases with your \c[61]Willpower\c[0].
translation:
奇怪的羊皮纸喷着火
前面有火力破坏 \c[60]3 瓷砖\c[0].
力量随你而增加 \c[61]意志力\c[0].

source:
A strange parchment that causes tremors.
Deals dmg in a \c[60]5x5 tile\c[0] area, knocks back
\c[60]3 tiles\c[0]. It's power accords with your \c[61]Attack\c[0].
translation:
奇怪的羊皮纸 引起震动
交易 dmg 在 \c[60]5页:15 瓷砖\c[0] 区域, 击倒
\c[60]3 瓷砖\c[0]. 力量与你的一样 \c[61]攻击\c[0].

source:
The tail that really grows on a Mimic.
Use it and for \c[60]7 turns\c[0] you are immobile,
but get \c[61]ATK\c[0] \c[60]+50%\c[0] and \c[61]Defense\c[0] \c[60]+50%\c[0].
translation:
尾巴真的长在Mamic上
使用它和为 \c[60]7 转弯\c[0] 你是不动的,
获取 \c[61]攻击\c[0] \c[60]+50%\c[0] 财务报告和已审计财务报表 \c[61]国防\c[0] \c[60]+50%\c[0].

source:
A uniquely chewy piece of Slime meat.
Eat it and get \c[61]HP\c[0] \c[60]+10\c[0] and \c[61]EN\c[0] \c[60]+65%\c[0].
However, you are poisoned for a long time.
translation:
一种独特的嚼肉肉。
吃起来,吃起来,吃起来 \c[61]生命\c[0] \c[60]+10\c[0] 财务报告和已审计财务报表 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+65%\c[0].
但是,你中毒了很长时间。

source:
A bone that comes from the arm or leg.
Hit an enemy with it and lower their \c[61]Defense\c[0],
give them \c[62]Curse\c[0], and break \c[61]Concentrate\c[0].
translation:
骨头从手臂或腿上流出来
用它击败敌人 降低他们 \c[61]国防\c[0],
给他们 \c[62]诅咒\c[0],然后断开 \c[61]集中\c[0].

source:
A rotten Nayuta Fruit
Eat it and \c[61]EN\c[0] \c[60]+30%\c[0].
But you will be \c[62]Food Poisoned\c[0].
translation:
腐烂的纳尤塔水果
吃起来,吃起来 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+30%\c[0].
但你会的 \c[62]食品中毒\c[0].

source:
Incorporeal meat. You're unsatisfied by it.
Eat it and get \c[61]EN\c[0] \c[60]+10%\c[0].
It will never rot.
translation:
无体肉 你对此不满意
吃起来,吃起来,吃起来 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+10%\c[0].
它永远不会腐烂。

source:
Keeps your items cool, and prevents rot.
Stops items burning from fire.
Performs an ice Force attack when thrown.
translation:
保持你的物品冷却,防止腐烂。
停止燃烧。
发射时会进行冰力攻击

source:
Repairs an exhausted body.
Cures Berserker Fatigue and Berserker status.
Recover \c[61]HP\c[0] \c[60]+100\c[0].
translation:
修理一个疲惫的身体。
库尔斯・伯瑟克・法蒂格和伯瑟克的状态
恢复 \c[61]生命\c[0] \c[60]+100\c[0].

source:
Use for \c[61]HP\c[0] \c[60]+10%\c[0] each turn and \c[61]ATK\c[0] \c[60]+60%\c[0] for
\c[60]20 turns\c[0]. However, \c[61]Max HP\c[0] \c[62]1/3\c[0], get \c[61]ATK\c[0] \c[60]+60%\c[0],
\c[61]Max ST\c[0] \c[62]1/3\c[0], \c[61]ACC\c[62] -10%\c[0], and low \c[61]Move Speed\c[0]
for next \c[60]30 turns\c[0].

A tribal artifact containing hellfire.
Use it and for about \c[60]30 turns\c[0], get
\c[61]Fire Resist\c[0] \c[60]80%\c[0], and \c[61]Fire Dmg\c[0] \c[60]-90%\c[0].

一个部落的文物 包含地狱之火。

\c[61]火焰抗性\c[0] \c[60]80%\c[0],并且 \c[61]火灾 Dmg\c[0] \c[60]-90%\c[0].

source:

一种奇怪的魅力 创造春天之前
you. A 级 \c[60]3页:13 瓷砖\c[0] 区域对水的变化。 这段时间
在水中 \c[61]命中\c[0] \c[60]-10%\c[0], \c[61]闪避\c[0] \c[60]+20%\c[0].

source:
A leaf that breaks up poison in the body.
Eat and \c[62]Poisoned\c[0], \c[62]Food Poisoned\c[0], and
\c[62]Dizzy\c[0] effects are healed and get \c[61]EN\c[0] \c[60]+10%\c[0].

一片能解开体内毒药的叶子

\c[62]头晕\c[0] 效果已经愈合 并获得 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+10%\c[0].

source:

\c[62]头晕\c[0] 效果已经愈合 并获得 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+10%\c[0].

source:

一个闻起来像它一样的午餐盒 会让你生病的

至少你得到 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+50%\c[0].

source:
This meat is definitely rotten. You can't even

translation:
这肉绝对是烂的。 你连

source:
A Potion that will make the opponent it hits fight

一个能让对手打起来的药剂
为你,直到死亡。
对一些怪物没有影响

source:
Deliciously cooked meat. It doesn't rot easily

translation:
美味的烹饪肉。 很难腐烂的
没有 \c[62]食品中毒\c[0] 不用担心。
吃起来,吃起来,吃起来 \c[61]生命\c[0] \c[60]+150\c[0], \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+80%\c[0].

source:
Well cooked meat. It doesn't rot easily
and there's no \c[62]Food Poisoning\c[0] to worry about.
Eat it and get \c[61]HP\c[0] \c[60]+30\c[0], \c[61]EN\c[0] \c[60]+25%\c[0].

煮的肉不错 很难腐烂的
没有 \c[62]食品中毒\c[0] 不用担心。
吃起来,吃起来,吃起来 \c[61]生命\c[0] \c[60]+30\c[0], \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+25%\c[0].

source:
A steel plate for cooking with Force.
Spices are also included.
Can cook up to \c[60]5\c[0] pieces of meat at a time.

和原力一起烹饪的钢板
也包括了香料。
能够烹饪到 \c[60]5\c[0] 一块肉一次。

source:
A strange parchment that can halve the speed

imbued with prayers for salvation.
translation:
奇怪的羊皮纸可以把速度减半
光之光的突袭片刻。 这是
充满了拯救的祈祷

source:
An Energy Drink infused with Force to improve
the taste. Drink it and get \c[61]HP\c[0] \c[60]+250\c[0]. However

一种能量饮料 注入了力量来改进
这味道。 喝吧,喝吧,喝起来 \c[61]生命\c[0] \c[60]+250\c[0]. 不过
你会变成 \c[62]头晕\c[0] 丧失了各种能力

source:
A large bottle filled with milk. It's a lot,
so it's bulky. Drink it and get \c[61]EN\c[0] \c[60]+40%\c[0].
It's said that it might rot into a good food...?
translation:
装满牛奶的大瓶子 这是很多,
所以,它是巨大的。 喝吧,喝吧,喝起来 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+40%\c[0].
据说它可能会腐烂成好食物?

source:
A food made from properly fermented milk.

translation:
一种由适当的发酵牛奶制成的食物。
吃起来,吃起来,吃起来 \c[61]饱食度\c[0] \c[60]+85%\c[0],还有一段时间得到
\c[61]HP 重现\c[0] \c[60]+100%\c[0].

source:
Once may have been food, but now hard and
lurid black. You won't be able to eat this safely.
In addition, the effective area is \c[60]3x3 tiles\c[0].

有一次可能是食物 但现在很难吃
疯狂的黑人。 你吃不下这个的
此外,有效的领域是: \c[60]3页:13 瓷砖\c[0].

source:

一颗炸弹在火力中释放出

source:

威斯曼的一小部份力量

有效使用盟国核电站 但不使用盟国

source:
A leaf that when eaten gives you vision in the
dark for \c[60]200 turns\c[0]. Also your \c[61]View Range\c[0] in

一片叶子,当被吃的时候, 让你在

吃完之后 叶子就会释放出来
一次强大的攻击

source:
An improved variety of Mandragora that's
not dangerous. But it's still scary. Eat and

美丽的石头闪耀着
就像彩虹一样 感觉很熟悉

source:

龙。 龙哥,你学功夫

Assassin Knife.

拿着它 \c[60]5\c[0] 扔出的武器
刺杀刀。

source:
A holy disposable weapon.
It's the strongest of thrown weapons and it
can break the Fallen Angel's barrier.
translation:
神圣的一次性武器
这是最强的 扔的武器和它
能够打破堕落天使的屏障

source:

用铁盔盖住你全身 使用它

\c[61]平方公尺\c[0] 是 \c[60]-80%\c[0]. 但是,你不能移动。

source:

translation:
面对问题的勇气的碎片。
如果你使用 3 你马上可以做一个圣人

Food preserved in a jar. It's a type of pickled

translation:
食物保存在一个罐子里。 这是一种泡菜
食物。 食物。 食物。 它不会腐烂,但它的大块头。

Nuts you think you can eat if you scrape

胡说八道,你觉得你刮得动就吃得下

source:
This difficulty is for beginners. You get a bonus 
of +10 to your WT limit. The Fallen Angel will 
appear at 400km, and defeating her will clear the game.

This difficulty is for intermediate players. When the
Fallen Angel appears you can choose to either
fight or avoid her and continue on.

source:
This difficulty is for advanced players. Enemies get 
stronger by the day, and you may be able to get 
items and recruit friends not obtainable in Normal mode.

这是对高级球员来说的难题 敌人得到 
日复一日,你也许能够

Hard Mode just wasn't enough. Enemies get stronger

has no effect. The Fallen Angel is stronger, and you can't

source:
\sysS[89]The \c[52]Dream Vault\c[0] is a place where you 
overcome the barriers of space and
time to transfer items.
translation:
\sysS[89]缩略语 \c[52]梦幻仓库\c[0] 是一个地方在那里你 
克服空间和空间障碍
转移物品的时间。

source:
\sysS[89]Storing items in the \c[52]Dream Vault\c[0] will be 
conducted \c[52]once an adventure ends\c[0].
translation:
\sysS[89]正在存储项目 \c[52]梦幻仓库\c[0] 将会是 
进行 \c[52]冒险一结束\c[0].

source:
\sysS[89]The Dream Vault will save the 
most recent instance of its use.
translation:
\sysS[89]梦之洞会拯救 
最近使用过它的例子。

source:
\sysS[89]If you go back to a saved adventure 
that you already received the rating results for, 
you \c[52]will not be able to use the Dream Vault\c[0].
translation:
\sysS[89]如果你回到一个拯救的冒险 
已经收到了评分结果 
你个混蛋 \c[52]将无法使用梦之洞\c[0].

source:
\sysS[89]Also... The \c[52]Dream Vault\c[0]'s contents will 
be \c[52]forcibly updated\c[0] with each newly 
finished adventure.
translation:
\sysS[89]还有... 缩略语 \c[52]梦幻仓库\c[0]内容将 
已经是 \c[52]强制更新\c[0] 与每个新建的 
结束了冒险。

source:
\sysS[89](If you didn't lose them, you can just put them
back in... I guess)
translation:
\sysS[89](如果你没有失去他们,你可以放他们)
回来... 我想是的,也许吧

<L>After learning about Cole's past, you fought together

<L>Draco continued growing during your travels and

context.row: 仲間（ドラコの好感度MAXで通常クリア）

context.row: 仲間（バルドフの好感度MAXで通常クリア）

<L>You protected the bond between Coco & Muddy and

... ... ... ...
Well, in a world like this, you know...
There are all kinds of folks, I guess.
translation:
... ... ... ...
在这样的世界里,你知道...
有很多种人,我想。

source: Oh?! Are you, by chance, the hero?
translation: 瓳? 你是那个英雄吗?

source:
I am the strongest mercenary,
the \c[51]Pants-Bandit\c[0]!
translation:
我是最强的雇佣兵
会 议 纪 要 \c[51]裤子银行\c[0]!
缩略语 \c[51]裤子银行\c[0]我说了!

source:
You don't have to repeat yourself!
That's quite a name...
translation:
你不用再说一遍!
这名字不错...

source:
It's all good... This name is quite
racy!! Top shelf raciness!
translation:
这一切都很好... 这个名字很像
赖西! 最顶端货架!

source:
What the heck is racy! I have no have
no idea what you're talking about, 
it just sounds weird!
translation:
什么他妈的是拉皮条! 我没有
不知道你在说什么 
这听起来很奇怪!

source:
Maybe I can find a better alias? The 
Pants-brigade? Or No-pants-dance?
It's tough to think of a good one...
translation:
也许我能找到更好的化名? 缩略语 
长裤套? 还是不穿裤子跳舞?
很难想出一个好的...

source:
Hey, just step away, will you!
You're just too...exhausting.
translation:
走开,好吗?
你只是太... 精疲力尽。

source:
In the middle of a journey? I am the
strongest of the mercenaries, but
unfortunately, I am on duty now.
translation:
在旅途中吗? 我就是那个
最强的雇佣兵,但
不幸的是,我现在在值班。

source:
I just recently found a job that's
paying pretty well, you know.
So I'm just going to take it easy.
translation:
我最近刚找到一份工作
支付相当不错,你知道的。
所以,我只是想放松下来。

source:
Even so, I still have to flee
\c[52]The Darkness\c[0].
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...

Huh? \c[52]The Darkness\c[0]
is...actually light though, right?
translation:
是吗? \c[52]黑暗\c[0]
确实很轻,对吧?

source:
Yes, the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]
that's swallowing the world.
translation:
是的,那个 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]
它吞噬了世界。

source:
It shines ominously. It is the perfect
opposite of \c[52]The Darkness\c[0]!
But it does look just as dangerous.
translation:
它不祥地闪耀着。 这是完美的
反向 \c[52]黑暗\c[0]!
但它看起来同样危险。

source:
\c[52]The Darkness\c[0] you're talking
about isn't the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]?
translation:
\c[52]黑暗\c[0] 你在说
有关是不是 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]?

source:
Hmm, it is the reverse of that light,
blacker than night, but certainly feels
similar in how it swallows the world.
translation:
嗯,这是反向的光,
比黑夜更黑,但确实感觉
类似它吞噬世界的方式

source:
All right, it's about time I began
preparations for my journey! We
could be overtaken at any moment!
translation:
好了,我该开始了
准备我的旅程! 我们
随时都有可能被超过!

source:
Oh, yes... I wanted to ask you more,
but it's fine. Thank you.
translation:
哦,对... 我想问你更多,
不过没关系 谢谢

source:
All right, it's about time I began
preparations for my journey! We
could be overtaken at any moment!
translation:
好了,我该开始了
准备我的旅程! 我们
随时都有可能被超过!

source:
Y-You can't just walk up on a lady
dressed like... THAT!
translation:
你不能随便走在女士身上
穿着像... 那个!

source:
Ah, actually, I have to stay this
way or I might die...
translation:
啊,实际上,我必须留下这个
不然我可能会死...

source:
I-Is that right...?
Sorry, I didn't know that...
translation:
是这样吗?
对不起,我不知道...

source:
You saved me, didn't you...
Thank you very much.
translation:
你救了我,不是吗?
非常感谢

source:
Aah, you saved me, didn't you...
Thank you very much.
translation:
啊,你救了我,不是吗...
非常感谢

source:
My name is \c[51]Frida\c[0]. I am
truly grateful that you rescued me
after the Demon Lord imprisoned me.
translation:
我的名字叫"我们" My name is \c[51]芙烈达\c[0]. 我是
真心感谢你救了我
在恶魔主囚禁我之后

source:
You're so blindingly beautiful!
And a queen? How cool!
translation:
你是如此盲目的美丽!
和女王吗? 好帅啊!

source:
Oh? You helped me too?
Thank you, truly.
translation:
是吗? 你也帮我?
谢谢你,真的。

source:
When \c[51]Coco\c[0] grows up,
\c[51]Coco\c[0] will be a beauty too.
translation:
何时 \c[51]可可\c[0] 长大了
\c[51]可可\c[0] 也会是个美人儿

source:
A demon?! It doesn't sound too
dangerous, does it...
Excuse me!
translation:
恶魔? 听起来不太像
危险吗?
对不起!

source:
However, she's so innocent... To
obey the king, then to be trapped by
the Demon Lord. How cruel!
translation:
但是,她是如此无辜... 写到
服从国王,然后被困
恶魔之王 真残忍!

source:
She's so innocent... To
obey the king, then to be trapped by
the Demon Lord. How cruel!
translation:
她是如此无辜... 写到
服从国王,然后被困
恶魔之王 真残忍!

source:
King? You met my father,
\c[51]King Victor\c[0]?
translation:
国王? 你见过我父亲
\c[51]维克多国王\c[0]?

source:
Wha?! You're part of the king's
family... Meaning you're a
princess?
translation:
什麽? 你是国王的一部分
家庭... ... 意思是说你是个
公主吗?

source:
Errmm, we met the king at
\c[54]Konrath's Castle\c[0], and we were asked
to slay the Demon Lord by him, but...
translation:
我们见过国王
\c[54]康拉斯城堡\c[0],我们被问
杀死恶魔之主,但...

source:
Oh right, so what's this...
Demon Lord like, anyway?
translation:
哦,对了,这是...
魔神一样吗?

source: Er, you don't know the Demon Lord?

Well... He holds a very strong power,
wielding \c[52]The Darkness\c[0] to destroy
the world. That's all I know...
translation:
这个嘛... 他拥有非常强大的力量,
挥舞 \c[52]黑暗\c[0] 摧毁
这个世界。 我只知道这些...

source:
I see... It does seem quite similar to
the \c[52]Envoy of Calamity\c[0]...
translation:
原来如此 这看起来和...
会 议 纪 要 \c[52]灾害问题特使\c[0]...

source: I'm sorry I wasn't of much help...

I'm thinking of setting out again, once
I've rested a bit more.
translation:
我想再准备一次
我休息了一会儿
\c[51]可可\c[0] 财务报告和已审计财务报表 \c[51]泥浆\c[0]你也要小心点!
好吧,我说... \c[51]芙烈达\c[0]! 嘘拜!

source:
I'm thinking of setting out again, once
I've rested a bit more.
translation:
我想再准备一次
我休息了一会儿

source:
The black knight clad in the ominous
aura looked this way.
translation:
黑骑士身陷险境
气压朝这边看

source:
Yikes... Uh oh, he looks strong...
Could it be...the Demon Lord?
translation:
恶心... 他看起来很强壮...
会不会是... 恶魔之王?

source:
In that attire, I can't see that knight
as being just another person. And
he doesn't look very friendly either.
translation:
穿那件衣服,我看不见那个骑士
做另一个人 还有
他看起来也不怎么友好

source:
The black knight draws his sword.
With that alone, the air is suddenly
heavy. Just breathing is difficult.
translation:
黑骑士拔剑
光是这个,空气就突然变了
重一点 只是呼吸困难。

source:
\c[51]Aerdou\c[0] is already standing with
his spear at the ready. He stares
the black knight straight in the eye.
translation:
\c[51]奥尔杜\c[0] 已经与
他的长矛就位 他盯着我看
黑骑士直指着眼睛

source:
As one that has survived so many
battlefields, it's understood. Being
careless here would be instant death.
translation:
活了这么多年
战场,它被理解。 成为
这里的粗心就是当场死亡

source:
Malice and death exude from the
knight and surround the heroes. They
prepare for a battle to the death...
translation:
背负和死亡
骑士和包围英雄。 他们
准备一场死亡之战...

source:
Whoops! He tripped on a \c[52]vial\c[0]
and fell!
translation:
呜呜! 他绊倒在 \c[52]瓶子\c[0]
掉下来了!

source:
Whoa! The \c[52]vial\c[0] broke on his face
and now he's soaked...
translation:
哇！ 缩略语 \c[52]瓶子\c[0] 他的脸被打碎了
现在他湿透了...

source:
The black knight rises to his feet, but
the malice from a moment ago
has vanished...
translation:
黑骑士站立在脚上
刚才的恶作剧
已经消失了...

source:
Nrgh, you cur...
Could it be that you fight for the
Demon Lord?!
translation:
呃，你这混蛋……
会不会是你为...
恶魔主?

source:
What?! Stop it, you're wrong!
Don't brandish your sword!!
translation:
什麽? 住手,你错了!
不要挥舞你的剑!

source:
Hmm, you're not working for
the Demon Lord?
translation:
嗯,你不是为
恶魔之王?

source:
\c[51]Aerdou\c[0]! You too! Lower
your spear! We are hunting the
Demon Lord, we're not enemies!
translation:
\c[51]奥尔杜\c[0]! 你也一样! 低一点
你的长矛! 我们在猎杀
恶魔主,我们不是敌人!

source:
Hmm, is that so... However,
damnit, I'm all sticky!
translation:
嗯,是这样... 不过
该死的,我太粘了!

source:
Ahahaa... Did you know
something about the
Demon Lord?
translation:
阿哈哈亚... 你知道吗?
有关
恶魔主?

source:
Do I...know something...?
Aah, perhaps, a moment ago I
snapped out of his brainwashing.
translation:
我... 知道什么吗?
啊,也许, 刚才我
从洗脑中解脱出来

source:
However, I am no longer under
mind control...
translation:
不过,我不再低
脑控制...

source:
It was undoubtedly my powerful
iron will that broke me free of his
mind control.
translation:
这无疑是我的强项
铁意志让我解脱
精神控制。 脑控制。

source:
R-Really? That's pretty impressive!
(Isn't the real reason because
you soaked yourself with the \c[52]vial\c[0]?)
translation:
真的吗? 真让人印象深刻
(这不是真正的原因,因为
你把自己浸湿了 \c[52]瓶子\c[0]?)

source:
Agh, burning time in a place like this
will not do at all!
I must search for princess \c[51]Frida\c[0]!
translation:
啊,在这样的地方燃烧的时光
根本不会!
我必须寻找公主 \c[51]芙烈达\c[0]!

source:
Huh? Do you know \c[51]Frida\c[0]?
Oh, he's gone.
translation:
是吗? 你知道吗? \c[51]芙烈达\c[0]?
哦,他不见了

source:
But, that Demon Lord, to be able to
control a person that strong...
We'd better be prepared, huh?
translation:
但是,恶魔主, 能够
控制一个人那么强大...
我们最好做好准备,是吧?

source:
However...it might have been a
mistake to miss an opportunity
to fight someone so strong.
translation:
但是... 这可能是...
错失机会
和这么强壮的人战斗

\c[51]奥尔杜\c[0],你正在不寻常
骑士般!

source:
Whoa! Out to make a fashion
statement or something?!
translation:
哇！ 出来制造时尚
口供还是什么?

source:
W-Well let's just forget that. 
I am sure you have a good reason. 
One that I really don't want to know...
translation:
我们忘了这个吧 
我敢肯定,你有一个很好的理由。 
一个我真的不想知道的...

source:
However, what I noticed after setting
out from the castle is... This world
is different from my own...
translation:
然而,我注意到,在设置
从城堡出来是... 这个世界
和我自己不一样...

source:
It appears that \c[52]The Darkness\c[0]
is not in this world.
translation:
看来 \c[52]黑暗\c[0]
已经不在这个世界了

source:
However, I sense signs of the
Demon Lord. He too has come
to this world.
translation:
然而,我感觉到了...
恶魔之王 他也来了
敬这个世界

source:
That light... Could it have some
connection to the Demon Lord?
I do not know...
translation:
光线... 来点吧
和恶魔之王的关系?
I do not know...

source:
However, if at all possible, I'd like
to ask you all to save this world...
translation:
但是,如果可能的话,我想
请求大家拯救这个世界...

source:
It would be good to meet the
Demon Lord once, too.
translation:
幸会
恶魔之王也曾有过一次

source:
You fool... So there are heroes
in this world too?
Hm... This is interesting indeed.
translation:
你这个笨蛋... 所以有英雄来了
在这个世界也?
额... Hm... 这确实令人感兴趣。

source:
You fool... Are you kidding me
turning up to face me as you
are now?
translation:
你这个笨蛋... 开什么玩笑
来面对我和你一样
是吗?

source:
I'm sorry.
There are reasons why I'm doing this.
translation:
对不起
我这么做是有原因的

source:
Urgh... Really...
In that case... I guess there's nothing
we can do, is there...
translation:
额... 真的……
这样的话... 我想没什么
我们可以做,有没有...

source:
A-are you the Demon Lord
\c[51]King Victor\c[0] spoke of?
translation:
你是魔王吗?
\c[51]维克多国王\c[0] 谈什么?

source:
Oh? So...
That one came this way too,
after all...
translation:
是吗? 这么说...
那个也来过这里
毕竟...

source:
This realm resembles that one...
Both are utterly devoid of hope.
translation:
这个王国就像那个...
两者都完全没有希望。

source:
It might be amusing to stay and
continue chatting with you weaklings,
but that "calamity" won't wait for me.
translation:
留下来也许很有趣
继续和你们这些弱者聊天,
但"灾星"不会等我的

source:
If you defeat me, it will stop
\c[52]The Darkness\c[0]... Perhaps, defeating
me might even stop that light?
translation:
如果你打败我,它就会停止
\c[52]黑暗\c[0]... 也许,失败了
我甚至可以停止光线?

source:
But! There's... No proof of that
anywhere!
translation:
不过! 这... 没有证据
随便你!

source:
Yes, there's no proof, but...
You're not someone who is capable
of defeating me in the first place.
translation:
是的,没有证据,但是...
你不是一个有能力的人
一开始就打败了我

source:
So stopping it is an
insurmountably impossible idea
anyway.
translation:
所以,停止它是一个
不可逾越的不可思议的想法
无论如何。

source:
Hmph, if you won't come to me,
I'll have to come after you! Hero!
translation:
嗯,如果你不来找我,
我一定要来追你! 英雄们!

source:
Heheh! Lemme join up
with the team, boss!
translation:
嘿嘿嘿！ 让我加入
和球队,老板!

source:
You already have three members in
your party. Koppa can't help you.
translation:
你已经有三个成员了
你的派对。 科帕帮不了你

嘿嘿嘿！
你真的是高端维护!

source:
This is...
the last medicinal herb!

I'm out of medicinal herbs...
Good luck!
translation:
我没药了...
祝你好运!

source:
Ouch, ow...
Well, I guess that's enough for today.
translation:
哎哟,哟...
今天就到此为止吧

source:
Huff... huff...
Well, I guess
that's enough for today.
translation:
... 胡说...
嗯,我猜,也许...
今天就到这里吧

瓳...
游荡英雄 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
哈啰!

source:
That's right! Recently,
I found something weird.
translation:
没错! 最近,我发现...
我发现了一些奇怪的东西

source:
It's pretty,
and I really like it, but...
translation:
这是漂亮的,
我真的很喜欢,但是...

source:
If this will
help you on your quest,
then I don't mind selling it to you!
translation:
如果这样
帮助你探险
那我不介意卖给你!

source:
Judging by the shape of the strange
stone, it might have originally been
part of an accessory.
translation:
从怪人的形状来判断
石头,它可能 本来是
帮凶的一部分

source:
And it seems to hold
some kind of a skill.
translation:
它似乎保持着
某种技能。

source:
What will you do? Buy this stone?
If so, you can use \c[51]Whack and Warp\c[0].
[Need \c[52]$tmp1 Lapis\c[0]]
translation:
你会怎么做? 买下这块石头?
如果有的话,你可以使用 \c[51]摇摆和摇摆\c[0].
[需要 \c[52]$tmp1 拉比斯\c[0]]

source:
Got it!
Good luck on your quest!
translation:
懂了吗?
祝你们好运!

source:
Hmmm... Sorry.
It seems you don't have enough cash!
translation:
嗯…… 对不起
看来你没有足够的现金!

source:
Okay, got it!
Then, take this.
translation:
好了,明白了! 开始!
那么,拿着这个

source:
Took the stone from Mamel.
You feel the power within the stone...
translation:
拿走了梅梅尔的石头
你感觉到石头里的力量...

source:
You can now use \c[51]Whack and Warp\c[0]!
This skill can only be used at night.
After attacking, you will warp.
translation:
你现在可以使用 \c[51]摇摆和摇摆\c[0]!
这种技能只能在晚上使用。
攻击后,你会扭曲。

source:
The Wanderer has balanced
attack and defense. Good at combos, 
critical hits, and the use of a shield.
translation:
漫游者已经平衡了
攻击和防御 不错的组合, 
和使用盾牌。

source:
Also good at finding dungeons.
Perhaps fated to be attracted
to dungeons.
translation:
也擅长找到地牢
也许注定要被吸引
到地牢来

source:
Nighttime skills can only be used,
well, at night, but their power
makes up for the inconvenience.
translation:
夜间技能只能使用,
嗯,在晚上,但他们的力量
弥补不便

\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 学习
\c[52]摇摆和摇摆\c[0] 技术!

source:
A t-talking... rabbit?
Erm, I'm \c[51]Memoria\c[0].
This is \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]...
translation:
说话... 兔子吗?
额,我... \c[51]梅莫莉娅\c[0].
这是 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]...

source:
Ah, I heard from the soldier!
You're the hero, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
translation:
啊,我听到的士兵!
你是那个英雄 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!

我吗?
打电话给我 \c[51]单调\c[0]请!

source:
Yes, I heard you're on a journey
to save the world,
you and the fairy...
translation:
是的,我听说你在旅行
为了拯救世界
你和那个仙女...

source:
I wish there was
some way I could help...
translation:
真希望还有
某种方式我可以帮助...

source:
I've got it!
I have a great idea!
translation:
我来吧!
我有个好主意!

source:
I could join you on your travels,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], and help you search
for things that would help you!
translation:
我可以和你一起旅行,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],帮助您搜索
为了能帮助你的东西!

哎哟!
不错的主意,对不对?

source:
How about it, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]?
Wanna hand over about \c[52]$tmp1 Lapis\c[0] to me?
translation:
怎么样? \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]?
想交出来 \c[52]$tmp1 拉比斯\c[0] 对我?

source:
I'll deeefinitely find you
something useful!
translation:
我一定会找到你的
有用的东西!

source:
Heeheehee.
Seems like you want to rely on

Hey, don't jinx her!
No, it isn't that.
translation:
嘿,别惹她!
不 不是那样的

对不起...
那么,这是 \c[51]纳米\c[0] 好吗?

source:
Really?
Good!
But then...why do you look so disturbed?
translation:
真的吗?
不错!
但是... 为什么你看起来这么不安?

source:
According to this \c[52]Messenger Raven\c[0]'s message...
\c[51]Nami\c[0] has been sighted as part of a gang of bandits.
translation:
根据这个 \c[52]信使乌鸦\c[0]信息...
\c[51]纳米\c[0] 被看成是匪帮的一部分

source:
There's no way I'd believe it.
\c[51]Nami\c[0] as a bandit, there must be some mistake.
translation:
我绝不会相信的
\c[51]纳米\c[0] 作为土匪,一定搞错了

source:
\c[51]Nami\c[0] must have been... Tricked into helping the
bandits. Or maybe she's a prisoner.
translation:
\c[51]纳米\c[0] 一定是... 应该是... 被骗去帮助
强盗 也许她是个囚犯

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], let's hurry east to where this
raven came from! If \c[51]Nami\c[0]'s been captured by
bandits, we've gotta help her!
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]让我们赶快往东走
乌鸦来了! 如果 : \c[51]纳米\c[0]被俘虏
强盗,我们得救她!

source:
Hey \c[52]Messenger Raven\c[0], follow up on this info!
We're counting on you!
translation:
顿 \c[52]信使乌鸦\c[0]追踪这个信息!
我们指望你!

source:
It looks like there's a convenient watering hole nearby.
We don't have much time, but how about a quick dip?
We've gotta stay fresh ourselves, too.
translation:
看起来附近有个方便的水坑
我们时间不多了,但跳个水怎么样?
我们也得保持新鲜

source:
...Right.
After all, haste makes waste, they say.
translation:
...没错。
他们说,毕竟,匆忙造成浪费。

source:
Now that you mention it!!
The \c[53]three\c[0] of us used to bathe together, back then!
translation:
既然你这么说了!
缩略语 \c[53]三个\c[0] 我们以前一起洗澡,那时候!
你个... \c[53]三个\c[0] 老朋友吗?

source:
By back then, you mean about \c[53]10 years\c[0] ago, right?
You \c[53]three\c[0] must have been so little and cu-ute.
translation:
那时候,你是说 \c[53]10 岁数\c[0] 之前,对不对?
你个... \c[53]三个\c[0] 一定是太小太可爱了

source:
Of course we were cute!
Well, the bathing was until about \c[53]2 years\c[0]
ago when I quit as caretaker, though.
translation:
我们当然很可爱!
洗个澡,直到 \c[53]2 岁数\c[0]
之前我辞去看管人职务的时候

source:
Uh? \c[53]Two years\c[0] ago?
Oh, right!
You mean, like, with a bathing suit on, right?
translation:
额? Uh? \c[53]两年\c[0] 之前吗?
哦,对了!
你是说穿着泳衣,对吧?

source:
Who wears a bathing suit into the bath?
You can't wash everywhere like that.
Obviously we were naked.
translation:
谁穿泳衣洗澡?
你不能像那样到处洗
显然我们是裸体的。

source:
Ack, so um... The \c[53]three\c[0] of you were pretty old to be
doing mixed sex bathing, buck naked...
translation:
阿克,所以,嗯... ... ... . 缩略语 \c[53]三个\c[0] 那时你已经很老了
做混合性爱浴, 公牛裸体...

source:
Obviously. As caretakers, we have to always be
close by \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
Isn't it the same for you, \c[51]Memoria\c[0]?
translation:
很明显 作为看管者,我们必须永远
关闭于 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
对你来说不是一样吗? \c[51]梅莫莉娅\c[0]?

source:
Well, I mean, I go into the bathroom with
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] just to check his health!
I'm a \c[52]fairy\c[0], so it's all right!
translation:
嗯,我的意思是,我要去 浴室与
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 只是为了检查他的健康!
我是一个 \c[52]童话\c[0]⊿闽玒

source:
Well, we're all right too, because we're old friends.
Right, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]?
translation:
我们也没事 因为我们是老朋友了
对 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]?

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
Come on! This is no time to be giggling to yourself!
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
来吧! 现在不是嘲笑自己的时候!

source:
...I've thought this for a while, but \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] is
pretty worldly, huh...?
translation:
我想了很久,不过... \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 是
很有风度,嗯?

source:
It's the \c[52]Messenger Raven\c[0].
A message from the east!
translation:
这是... \c[52]信使乌鸦\c[0].
东方传来的消息!

source:
What's up?
What does the letter...
translation:
这是怎么回事?
信上写了什么...

source: \c[51]Nami\c[0]'s been captured by a group of vigilantes...
translation: \c[51]纳米\c[0]被一群治安维持者抓走了

source:
She was in the slum town to the east,
working with some "give to the poor" type bandits...
translation:
她在东边的贫民窟里
和一些"给穷人"的土匪合作...

source:
Apparently she was given an immediate
death sentence...
translation:
显然她被立即送去了
死刑...

source:
Wa-wait a second...
That has got to be some kind of a mistake...
translation:
华... 等等...
一定是搞错了...

source:
The seal on this letter...
It's from the \c[52]Messenger Raven\c[0] contact I trust the most.
translation:
这封信上的封条...
这是从 \c[52]信使乌鸦\c[0] 联系我最信任的人

source:
And this...
It was tied to the \c[52]Messenger Raven\c[0]'s leg.
translation:
还有这个...
它被绑在 \c[52]信使乌鸦\c[0]脚

source:
...A locket pendant?
What's this... It's all bloody...
translation:
吊坠?
这是什么... 这都是血腥的...

source:
\c[51]Nami\c[0] always had this with her.
She even wore it in the bath, and to sleep...
translation:
\c[51]纳米\c[0] 总是有这个和她在一起。
她甚至穿着它洗澡, 并睡觉...

source:
According to the letter, it seems she was beheaded...
This was an article taken from her at the execution site.
translation:
根据信,她好像被砍头了...
这是在行刑地点从她身上拿走的一篇文章

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
If you had gone to rescue \c[51]Nami\c[0] instead of me,
this could have been stopped!
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
如果你去营救 \c[51]纳米\c[0] 而不是我, 而不是我,
这本可以被阻止的!

source:
If I hadn't hurt my leg trying to protect you!
I could have been by \c[51]Nami\c[0]'s side!
translation:
如果我没有伤到腿来保护你!
我本来可以去的 \c[51]纳米\c[0]这边!
\c[51]纳米\c[0]谋杀是... 这是你的... 欧格...

source:
What are you saying?
You can't take this out on \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
translation:
你说什么?
你不能把这个拿出来 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!

source: Urgh... Urrghhh... That's right. This is my fault.
translation: 额... 乌尔格... 没错 这是我的错。

source:
If I hadn't joined you, and gone instead to
aid \c[51]Nami\c[0], this never would have...
translation:
如果我没有加入你, 并去了
援助 \c[51]纳米\c[0]这绝对不可能...

source: Are you okay? Have you calmed down a little?
translation: 你没事吧? 你冷静下来一点吗?

source:
...Sorry for blowing up.
I... Blaming \c[51]Nami\c[0]'s death on you.
Even though I know you're suffering too. I'm terrible.
translation:
...对不起炸掉。
I... 诽谤 \c[51]纳米\c[0]死在你头上
虽然我知道你也在受苦 我太逊了

source:
Timid, but more than that, kind \c[51]Nami\c[0]...
So... that was the last time...
translation:
时间短,但不止于此,善良 \c[51]纳米\c[0]...
这么说... 这是最后一次...

source:
...I'm sorry, \c[51]Nami\c[0]...
I may be in mourning for quite a while, but...
I'm going to keep helping them.
translation:
对不起 \c[51]纳米\c[0]...
我可能已经哀悼了一段时间了,但是...
我会继续帮他们

source:
I'm...fine.
From now I will be your shield and sword,
and fight by your side.
translation:
我没事
从现在开始,我将成为你们的盾牌和剑
并战斗在你身边。

source:
Ah! \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! What are you doing here?
Didn't you set out to slay the \c[52]Envoy of Calamity\c[0]?
translation:
摆! \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! 你在这里做什么?
你不是打算去杀那个 \c[52]灾害问题特使\c[0]?

source:
Ah! Whaaa! Hero! What are you doing here?
Or rather, why are you dressed like that?
Didn't you set out to slay the \c[52]Envoy of Calamity\c[0]?
translation:
摆! 呜呜! 英雄们! 你在这里做什么?
或者说 为什么你穿成这样?
你不是打算去杀那个 \c[52]灾害问题特使\c[0]?

source:
No, well, that's because of some personal
circumstances, if they weren't dressed like this they'd
be dead.
translation:
不,那是因为一些私人问题
情况,如果他们没有穿成这样,他们会
已经死了。

source:
We came to rescue you.
Well, actually, to get you to help us.
translation:
我们是来救你的
其实是为了让你帮我们

source:
Just to get me?
Th-thank you so much!
translation:
就为了抓我?
非常感谢!

source:
Um, but... Is \c[51]Keyton\c[0] okay?
Because his legs are disabled...
translation:
嗯,不过... 是 \c[51]键\c[0] 好吗?
因为他的腿是残疾的...

source:
He's fine. \c[51]Keyton\c[0] is \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s
caretaker and his instructor in the martial arts.
He can easily make it out on \c[53]his own\c[0].
translation:
他没事 \c[51]键\c[0] 是 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]编号(_A):
看守和他的武术教练
他很容易就脱身了 \c[53]他自己吗?\c[0].

source:
You're completely right...
If I was with him, I'd just be a burden...
translation:
你说得对...
如果我和他在一起,我会成为一个负担...

source:
More than that, we want you to help us.
Bring down the \c[52]Envoy of Calamity\c[0] with us!
translation:
不仅如此,我们希望你能帮助我们。
带下来 \c[52]灾害问题特使\c[0] 和我们一起!

source:
Me, bring down the \c[52]Envoy of Calamity\c[0]?
Th-that's completely impossible! I'd just be in the way!
translation:
我,拿下来 \c[52]灾害问题特使\c[0]?
这... 这完全不可能! 我只是在挡路!

source:
Not at all!
You've been working as \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s
caretaker up until now, and you're a first-rate \c[52]Sorcerer\c[0]!
translation:
一点也不!
你一直工作为: \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]编号(_A):
一直照顾你,你是一流的 \c[52]理术师\c[0]!

source:
Come on, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
Tell her you agree with me!
translation:
来吧, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
告诉她你同意我的话!

source:
...Okay.
If \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] says so.
If you'll have the likes of me... I'll join you!
translation:
...Okay.
如果 : \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 这么说。
如果你喜欢我的话... 我加入你们!

source:
Great, now let's get going!
The \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] is nipping at our heels!
translation:
太好了,现在让我们去!
缩略语 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0] 我们的脚跟被踩到了!

source:
Eh? You don't want to work together?
I see... Well, if that's your decision,
I guess I'll just have to abide.
translation:
额? 你不想合作吗?
原来如此 好吧,如果这是你的决定,
我想我必须坚持下去

source:
Sorry, \c[51]Nami\c[0].
But you of all people can escape on \c[53]your own\c[0], right?
translation:
对不起 \c[51]纳米\c[0].
但你能逃出来 \c[53]自己买的\c[0]对不对?

source:
Yes, I'll be all right.
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], take care of yourself.
translation:
是的,我会没事的。
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]照顾好自己

source:
Uh, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
You changed your mind after all?
Wanna have \c[51]Nami\c[0] join us?
translation:
额... \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
你还是改主意了?
想要吗? \c[51]纳米\c[0] 加入我们?

source:
Sorry, but I know I'll just be a burden
so I can't come with you after all.
I'm really sorry.
translation:
对不起,但我知道我只是个负担
所以我不能和你一起去
对不起

source:
Sad as it is, it appears we just lack
the charisma to get her to join us.
translation:
可悲的是,我们似乎只是缺乏
魅力让她加入我们的行列

source:
Ah... I-I'm sorry.
N-no.
I j-just have something in my eye.
translation:
摆... 对不起
没有
我眼睛里有东西

source:
Anyway, thank you very much
for letting me come along with you
on the journey this time.
translation:
总之,谢谢你
让我跟你一起来
这一次的旅程。

source:
Right... as thanks for saving me,
this time please let me be \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s
caretaker again.
translation:
对... 感谢您救了我
这次请让我做 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]编号(_A):
又是看门人

source:
Aren't you two old friends?
Why are you being so stiff with each other?
translation:
你们不是老朋友吗?
你们为什么这么僵硬?

source:
"Old friends"...
Sounds like \c[51]Keyton\c[0] was exaggerating.
I was really just, kind of, there.
translation:
"Old friends"...
听起来像 \c[51]键\c[0] 有点夸张
我真的只是, 有点,在那里。

source:
I was just a kid who grew up poor,
a slow-moving, gullible rabbit.
translation:
我只是个孩子 谁长大穷,
一只缓慢移动,容易骗人的兔子。

source:
Hee hee.
You mean, cute like a rabbit?
translation:
熙熙熙来了。
你是说像兔子一样可爱?

source:
N-No!
By rabbit, I meant afraid to be alone!
translation:
N-No!
兔子,我是说害怕一个人!

source:
Both \c[51]Keyton\c[0] and I lost our parents to war when
we were kids, and in a way we supported each other.
translation:
两者 \c[51]键\c[0] 我失去了我们的父母 在战争中
我们还是个孩子, 在某种程度上,我们支持对方。

source:
Even me becoming \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s caretaker was
only because \c[51]Keyton\c[0] invited me.
translation:
连我都变成 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]守护者是
只是因为 \c[51]键\c[0] 邀请我。

source:
I see. Both you and \c[51]Keyton\c[0]...
lost your parents in the war that \c[51]King Konrath\c[0]
started, huh.
translation:
原来如此 无论是你还是 \c[51]键\c[0]...
在战争中失去你的父母 \c[51]康拉特国王\c[0]
开始,呵呵。

source:
Er, no!
I didn't mean it like that!
translation:
额,不!
我不是那个意思!

source:
Whatever, it's the truth anyway.
Hey, even \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] agrees.
translation:
无论如何,这是事实。
嘿,连 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 同意。 同意。 同意。

source:
Anyway, please let me help you.
If I don't do that, I'll never feel closure.
I'm begging you!
translation:
无论如何,请让我帮你。
如果我不这样做,我永远不会感到结束。
我请求你!

source: Well let's just agree we need each other, \c[51]Nami\c[0].
translation: 好吧,让我们只是同意 我们需要对方, \c[51]纳米\c[0].

source:
To be able to join up with \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] again
like this now, it's really an honor.
translation:
能够加入 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 又来了
就像现在这样 真是荣幸

source:
Maybe it's because I grew up poor, but I have
always wanted to be alongside \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
translation:
也许是因为我长大了 穷,但我有
一直想与我同在 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
When I was allowed to work as \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s
caretaker... It was like a dream come true.
translation:
当我被允许工作的时候 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]编号(_A):
守护者... 这就像梦想成真。

source:
For that reason, even now it's like I am in an unending
dream.
translation:
因为这个原因,即使现在,它就像我在一个永无止境
做梦

source:
I hope to be of use to \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]. Not like before,
where I was simply tagging along with \c[51]Keyton\c[0]...
I want to work hard as \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s caretaker.
translation:
我希望对你们有用 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]. 和以前不一样
在那里,我只是 跟着 \c[51]键\c[0]...
我想尽心尽力 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]是看门人

source: If it's for \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], I'll do anything!
translation: 如果是为了... \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我会做任何事情!

source:
A girl who's of age saying she'll do anything!
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], that's more than you could hope
for, eh?! eh?!
translation:
一个年纪大的女孩说她会做任何事!
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]这比你所希望的还要多
为了,是吗? 是吗?

source: I'll... I'll push my body to the limit!
translation: 我会... 我会把我的身体推到极限!

source:
Whenever she gets worked up like that, the heaving
bosom under her pendant jiggles, and to go as far as
to say she'll push herself to the limit, isn't it inspiring?
translation:
每当她这么激动时,就摇摆着
胸在她的胸前摇动, 并一直走到
说她会把自己推到极限, 是不是令人振奋?

source:
Hey, \c[50]M-Memoria\c[0]!
Would you please not make those kinds of jokes.
It's really embarrassing!
translation:
顿 \c[50]M-Memoria(米莫里亚)\c[0]!
请你别开这种玩笑
这真的很尴尬!

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] and \c[51]Nami\c[0] and \c[51]Keyton\c[0]
must have been pretty close, right?
I mean, since you say you are all old friends.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 财务报告和已审计财务报表 \c[51]纳米\c[0] 财务报告和已审计财务报表 \c[51]键\c[0]
一定很亲近吧?
既然你说你们都是老朋友了

source:
Huh? Y-yeah...
At least, that was what I thought.
translation:
是吗? 对...
至少,这就是我的想法。

source:
So uh, I mean, as would be normal for people who
were that close, did the \c[53]three\c[0] of you maybe
ever bathe together?
translation:
所以,我的意思是, 和正常人一样
有那么近吗? \c[53]三个\c[0] 对你也许
曾经一起洗澡吗?

source:
\c[51]Memoria\c[0], wanting to ask something like that..
You're quite a dirty fairy, aren't you?
translation:
\c[51]梅莫莉娅\c[0]想要问类似的东西...
你真是个肮脏的仙女,不是吗?

source:
You think so? Bathing together as kids I didn't think
that was that weird...
translation:
你这么认为? 小时候一起洗澡 我没想到
那是那个奇怪的...

source:
Huh? Oh, y-yeah...
Y-yeah, absolutely, right?
translation:
是吗? 哦,是的,没错...
是的,绝对,对不对?

source:
Uh, \c[51]Nami\c[0], why are you so red?
Wait... You mean, it wasn't just when you were kids...?
translation:
额... \c[51]纳米\c[0]你为什么这么红?
慢着... 你的意思是,它不只是 当你还是孩子... ?

source:
A-actually...
It was up until \c[53]two years\c[0] ago, when I was let

以其极度危险闻名!

source:
There are \c[53]99%\c[0] odds of getting lost in there,
and the monsters are staggeringly strong.
translation:
这儿有 \c[53]99%\c[0] 在那里迷路的几率
和怪物是惊人的强大。

source:
It's a pretty good bet if we go in there,
we'll be taken over by the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0].
translation:
如果我们进去的话,这下赌注还不错
我们将会被 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0].

source:
But, the medicinal plants are ridiculously valuable!
It would reimburse the costs of what I eat,
and then some, so it'll kill two birds with one stone!
translation:
但是,药用植物是 荒谬的有价值的!
它会偿还我吃的东西的费用,
然后一些,所以它会杀死两只鸟 用一块石头!

source:
Paaaassss! We don't even need special medicine.
And we can get medicinal plants along the way anyway,
and it's not like we're hurting for money!
translation:
猫头鹰! 我们甚至不需要特殊药物。
而且我们可以在路上买药用植物
我们又不是为钱而受伤!

source:
Hmmm...
But our eating supplies are going to dwindle fast.
You're fine with that?
translation:
嗯……
但我们的食物供应会迅速减少
你同意吗?

source:
If it comes to that, we can just toss the cause of
the problem out, so it's no problem.
translation:
如果这样的话,我们可以抛开
问题解决了,所以没问题。

source:
Terrible... You're too terrible. Inhuman.
All right, I'm going to put the demonic behavior of
this girl into song, and debut it tonight!
translation:
差劲... 你太差劲了 异形。
好吧,我要把恶魔行为
这个女孩唱了首歌,今晚就出场!

source:
Hey \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
would it really be all right if we tossed this guy out?
translation:
顿 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
我们把他扔出去真的没问题吗?

source:
I heard it through the \c[52]Messenger Raven Network\c[0],
but there's a town to the east of here holding
a big eating competition.
translation:
我听到它通过 \c[52]信使雷文网络\c[0],
但这里东边有个镇子
一场大吃大喝的比赛
为什么我们不顺路过来?

source: Naturally, if we participate, I can win the prize!
translation: 自然,如果我们参加,我可以赢得奖品!

source:
Hey, you're a \c[52]troubadour\c[0], haven't you ever heard of
earning money by singing in the bar rooms?
translation:
嘿,你是一个 \c[52]粗鲁\c[0]你从没听说过
在酒吧里唱歌赚钱?

source:
It's not like I sing
out of a love of money.
translation:
我又不是在唱歌,我不喜欢唱歌
为了钱的爱

source:
It's a sensation I experienced upon first becoming free.
I want to tell everyone of the wondrousness of
this world, and that's why I sing.
translation:
这是我刚获得自由时体验到的感觉
我想告诉大家
这个世界,所以我唱歌。

source:
It's great being a leaf in the wind and all,
but don't your parents back home worry about you?
translation:
当风中的叶子真好
但你父母不担心你吗?

source:
Well, in this situation, it's not like 
we should really be worrying about you, but yeah.
translation:
那么,在这种情况下,它不喜欢 
我们应该真的担心你,但是是的。

source:
Hrm...
I cut ties with my parents \c[53]a year ago\c[0].
translation:
额...
我和父母断绝了关系 \c[53]一年前\c[0].

source:
They're different people now.
There's no connection to me now.
translation:
他们现在不一样了
现在跟我没有联系了

source: So, can I please participate in this competition?
Fine, but be quick and get it over with.
translation: 好吧,但要快点 并把它了结。

source:
And as much as you're requesting freedom,
this is our journey. 
Are there any problems with that?
translation:
虽然你要求自由
这是我们的旅程。 
有什么问题吗?

source: Not particularly, it's a fun trip, I welcome it.
translation: 不是很特别,这是一个有趣的旅行,我欢迎它。

source:
Heh heh heh... No one stands a chance against me
for first place in this competition.
translation:
Heh heh heh... 没有人有机会和我对着干
在这场比赛中排名第一

source:
Er, that's not the \c[52]troubadour\c[0] talking, is it?
Hm? Isn't that the \c[52]Messenger Raven\c[0]?
Looks like a message for \c[51]Baldur\c[0].
translation:
呃,这不是 \c[52]粗鲁\c[0] 说话,是吗?
嗯？ 这不就是 \c[52]信使乌鸦\c[0]?
看起来像是给 \c[51]巴尔杜尔\c[0].

source:
From where?
Let me look at it!
translation:
从哪里来的?
让我看看!

source:
Isn't this from your parents?
Is your father sick?
translation:
这不是你父母寄来的吗?
你父亲病了吗?

source: Well, it's got nothing to do with me.

As I told you before, I live as a free spirit.
I parted ways with my parents.
My father even told me not to come back.
translation:
正如我之前告诉你的 我活得像一个自由的灵魂
我和父母分开了
我父亲甚至叫我不要回来

source:
But you have to go back.
I mean they're going as far as sending letters.
They definitely want you to come home!
translation:
但你必须回去
我的意思是,他们去 远至发送信件。
他们绝对希望你回家!

source:
Say whatever you want.
I now have the heavy duty of
saving the world.
translation:
随你怎么说
我现在有重任
拯救世界。

source:
It's not like I'm just going to turn my back on that now.
Or, are you throwing me out?
translation:
我又不是要背弃它
还是你要把我赶出去?

source:
...Give me a break. Talk about ingratitude for
the people who brought you into this world.
translation:
饶了我吧 说到忘恩负义
把你带进这个世界的人

source:
Looks like another message for \c[51]Baldur\c[0].
From your parents?
Which one, lemme see!
translation:
看起来像是另一个消息 \c[51]巴尔杜尔\c[0].
你父母送的吗?
哪一个,让我看看!

source:
"Father is terribly ill". Your father's is sick!
What are you gonna do? This doesn't make
you want to go home?
translation:
"父亲病得很重" 你父亲病了!
你打算怎么办? 这可不行
你想回家吗?

source: ...But I have been disinherited. I can't just go back now.
translation: 但我已经被剥夺继承权了 我现在不能回去了

source:
You are not very honest... But for your stubbornness
to persist even after this, isn't that just stupid?
Your dad might be dead soon, you know?
translation:
你不太诚实... 但因为你的固执
即便这样 也要坚持下去 是不是太愚蠢了
你爸爸可能不久就死了 你知道吗?

source:
There's no point going home empty-handed...
Without the medicinal plant,
there is just no value in my going home!
translation:
空手回家没有意义...
没有药用植物
我回家没有价值!

source:
Medicinal plant? The ones that you mentioned
grow in the \c[54]Forest of Contour\c[0]?
translation:
药厂? 你提到的那些
生长在 \c[54]轮廓森林\c[0]?

source:
There is no way to cure my father
but to boil that plant and make him drink it.
translation:
没有办法治好我父亲
却把植物煮了 让他喝下去

source:
But... I simply lack the strength to
go into that forest and return alive.
translation:
不过... 我只是缺乏力量
回到那片森林里 活着回来

source:
...I have an earnest request for you!
I need that plant, to cure my father!
translation:
...我有一个真诚的请求给你!
我需要那棵植物来治愈我父亲!

source:
I want to cure my father...
Please, I'm begging you!
Please help me!
translation:
我想治愈我父亲...
求你了,我求你了! 我求你了! 我求你了,我求你了!
请帮帮我!

source: ...You're not going to help me...are you?

Look, your father's life hangs in the balance, right?
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]'s not just going to ignore that.
See, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] is agreeing.
translation:
你看,你父亲的生命 悬在平衡,对不对?
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]不只是无视这一点。
看见没? \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 已经同意了。

source:
Then, let's go.
Coincidentally, that forest is very close to here.
translation:
那么,我们走吧。
顺便说一下,那片森林离这里很近

source:
Wheee! 
That was pretty sketchy, but we made it!
translation:
呜! 
说来话长,不过我们成功了

source:
Thanks, guys.
This will save my father, too.
translation:
谢谢 伙计们
这也能救出我父亲

source: I will never forget my debt to you!
translation: 我永远不会忘记欠你的债!

source:
I, \c[51]Baldur\c[0], pledge to you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], that I will
fight heart and soul to help you save the world!
translation:
I, \c[51]巴尔杜尔\c[0]向你发誓 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我会的
为拯救世界而奋斗!

source:
Hmmm?!
Villain, thou art \c[51]King Konrath\c[0]'s progeny,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
translation:
嗯？！
恶棍,你 \c[51]康拉特国王\c[0]'子孙,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!

source:
Hmmm?!
Thy perversion is clear at a glance.
Villain, thou art \c[51]King Konrath\c[0]'s progeny!
translation:
嗯？！
你的反常一看就知道了
恶棍,你 \c[51]康拉特国王\c[0]是子孙!

source:
I am \c[51]Aerdou\c[0]!
I am a \c[52]court knight\c[0] serving a land savaged by
thy murderous father, \c[51]Konrath\c[0]!
translation:
我是 \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0]!
我是一个 \c[52]宫殿骑士\c[0] 服务于一个被野蛮的土地
你那凶残的父亲 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0]!

source:
In the stead of the late king,
I will strike thee down! En garde!
translation:
代替已故国王
我会打倒你! 预备!

source:
...To think there is one that my lance cannot fell...
I can scarce believe...
translation:
...想有一个 我的长矛不能掉下来...
我简直不敢相信...

source:
That there is one such as my lance cannot fell...
And this perverse creature, at that...
I can scarce believe...
translation:
我的长矛不能掉下来...
这个变态的怪物...
我简直不敢相信...

source:
I think you know the reason why,
if you examine your heart...
translation:
我想你知道为什么
如果你检查你的心脏...

source:
Hero! Knight \c[51]Aerdou\c[0] is said to be a match for
a thousand men, the foremost spearman in the world.
translation:
英雄们! 骑士 \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0] 据说是匹配的
一千人,世界上最伟大的长矛手

source:
Sorry, but the hero is not one
who takes lives needlessly.
translation:
对不起,但英雄不是一个人
他们不必要地夺走生命。

source:
Fool! Thou wouldn'st make me bear
the shame of living?
translation:
蠢货! 你会让我承受
活着的耻辱?

source:
That's not it.
We were wondering if you might not join us.
translation:
不是那样的
我们想知道,如果你可能 不加入我们。

source:
I think you know, but, we have to somehow
stop this calamity and save the world.
translation:
我想你知道,但是,我们必须 不知怎的
停止这场灾难,拯救世界。

source:
Someone as strong as you,
you seem like you could be depended on.
translation:
像你这样强壮的人
你似乎可以依赖。

source:
Or rather, are you going to commit honorable suicide
to avoid the shame of living?
But that isn't really in chivalrous spirit, is it?
translation:
或者说,你打算做 体面的自杀
避免活着的耻辱?
但这不是真的有骑士精神,是吗?

source:
Hmm, I see. To be a fellow traveler on thy 
journey. To witness thee tortured to death 
might bring me some small amusement.
translation:
原来如此 做一个旅行者 
一路顺风 眼睁睁看着你被折磨到死 
也许会带给我一些小娱乐

source:
Understood. Then, that I may burn thy
final moments into mine eyes,
I shall accompany thee on thy quest.
translation:
Understood. 那样我就能烧死你
进入我眼中的最后一刻
我会陪着你去探险

source:
His motive is pretty impure, but...
We have gained a very strong ally...
Is what I should take from this, right?
translation:
他的动机是相当不干净,但是...
我们得到了一个非常强大的盟友...
我该从中汲取什么,对不对?

source:
Huh?
Refusing to bring someone
this strong along?
translation:
是吗?
拒绝带人来
这么强大吗?

source:
So be it, then slay me! If thou won't,
I shall one day emerge from the shadows
and drive this spear through thee!
translation:
那就这样吧 杀了我吧 如果你不愿意的话
终有一天我会从阴影中浮现出来
把长矛开过去!

source:
If you're not going to bring him along,
we should probably get out of here now...
translation:
如果你不带他一起走
我们也许应该离开这儿...

source:
Oh, you changed your mind after all?
Wanna have \c[51]Aerdou\c[0] join us?
translation:
哦,你改变主意了?
想要吗? \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0] 加入我们?

source:
Alas, I refuse!
In the end, thou art naught but the heir of
hated \c[51]Konrath\c[0]! To join thee is unthinkable!
translation:
唉,我拒绝!
归根结底,你只是继承人
讨厌 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0]! 加入你简直不可思议!

source:
Sad as it is, it appears we just lack
the charisma to get him to join us.
translation:
可悲的是,我们似乎只是缺乏
魅力让他加入我们的行列

source:
O \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], I tremble with joy at the
thought that I may see thee slain ignominiously.
translation:
欧 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我欢乐地颤抖着
认为我可能会看见你被卑贱地杀害。

source:
Hey, hey!
Is that any way to talk to an ally on this journey?
translation:
喂，喂！
这条路能和盟友谈吗?

source:
You're not... Planning to just jump out
from behind and GGSSHHH! with that spear... right?
translation:
你没有... 计划只是跳出来
从后面和GGSSHHHH! 用那根长矛... 对吧?

source:
The cheek. I am a knight with the pride of
serving the court. I shall not engage in such
dishonor as ambushing a travel mate.
translation:
脸颊 我是一个骑士 与骄傲
服务于法庭 我不会参与这样的
羞耻的像伏击一个旅行伙伴。

source: Well, that's fine then, in that case.

However, it is a true disappointment that my
ancient foe \c[51]Konrath\c[0] was swallowed by
the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0].
translation:
然而,这真是令人失望的是,我的
古老的敌人 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0] 被吞没
会 议 纪 要 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0].

source: You feel such sympathy for a foe?

It was my intention to see \c[51]Konrath\c[0]
on the end of this spear. I only regret not delivering
the killing blow with mine own hand.
translation:
我本来想看的 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0]
在长矛的尽头 我只是后悔没送东西
我亲手的致命打击

source: And now the spearhead is aimed at \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

Hm? Hold on.
When we reach the culprit of this crisis,
will you actually fight alongside of us, \c[51]Aerdou\c[0]?
translation:
嗯？ 坚持住。
当我们找到危机的凶手时
你会和我们一起战斗吗? \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0]?

source: Or do you intend to switch sides?

I intend to stand aside and watch dispassionately
whilst ye do combat.
translation:
我打算站到一边 冷静地看着
你们战斗的时候,
之后呢? And, after that? 然后呢?

source:
If we were to lose, you would be left
on \c[53]your own\c[0], you know.
translation:
如果我们输了,你会被丢下
开 开 \c[53]自己买的\c[0]你知道,我们... ...

source:
In truth, I had not considered what comes after that.
However, at that point I might betray you,
and call myself the Knight of Absolute Despair, \c[51]Aerdou\c[0].
translation:
事实上,我没有考虑过之后会发生什么。
不过,在那个时候,我可能会背叛你
称自己为绝望骑士 \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0].

source:
I jest. In truth, there would be no path for me
but to throw down the gauntlet myself,
in the name of human dignity.
translation:
我开玩笑的 说实话,我没有路可走
但为了抛下自己的畏缩
以人的尊严为名。

source:
Even though you couldn't defeat \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
you'd challenge someone who had?
THAT'S more "absolute despair".
translation:
即使你无法击败 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
你会挑战一个曾经有过的人吗?
这更"绝对绝望"。

source:
In that case, just join the fight from the beginning.
The past is past.
translation:
这样的话,从一开始就加入战斗吧
过去已经过去了

source: Hrmph, I cannot have that discussion.
translation: 赫姆夫,我不能讨论这个

source: Yes, wonderful. This is a rather nice journey.
translation: 是的,很不错。 这是一个相当不错的旅程。

source:
Rapt with shining his spear, apparently.
Did something good happen?
translation:
猛禽用闪亮的长矛,显然。
发生什么好事了吗?

source:
Yes, good things happen every day.
Thy master, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], is
cut and struck by enemies, and his blood doth flow.
translation:
是的 每天都有好事发生
你的主人, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],是
被敌人割伤 血流成河

source:
What I wish to see is the wicked child of
\c[51]Konrath\c[0], cut down before my eyes.
The more thou art injured, the greater my joy.
translation:
我想看到的是邪恶的孩子
\c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0]在我眼前被砍下来
你受伤越多,我就越高兴

source:
Every day I am treated to such a show.
I was right to agree to join thee on this journey.
translation:
每天我都会被这样对待
我同意加入你的旅程是对的

source:
In that way, thou art a splendid performer.
It would not be too much to say I have become a fan.
translation:
这样的话,你是一个出色的表演者。
说自己是粉丝不会太过分的

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], of all the fans you could have,
you got one with terrible interests.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]所有的粉丝,你可以有,
你有一个 与可怕的兴趣。

source:
It occurs to me that when thou art slain,
I will no longer be able to gaze about thy wounded form.
translation:
我忽然想到,当你被杀死的时候,
我再也看不见你受伤的样子了

source:
With this mind, if I guard you and keep thee not dead,
nor fully mended either, I can extend this pleasure.
translation:
带着这个想法 如果我保护你 让你永不死
也没有完全的修补, 我可以给予这一乐趣。

source:
Yes, today I will guard thee,
letting thee neither live nor die. 
Ah ha ha!
translation:
是的,今天我会保护你
让你生不死 
啊哈哈！

source:
That's uh, beyond revenge, almost more to
the point of S&M... \c[51]Aerdou\c[0],
you've just got a major sadism fetish, don't you?
translation:
不止是报仇 几乎更多
S&M的要点... \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0],
你只是有 主要的虐待狂倾向,不是吗?

source:
Thinking of it now...
Had thy wicked father summoned me to thy country,
we would not have found ourselves in this situation.
translation:
现在想起来...
万一你邪恶的父亲召唤我来到你的国家
我们不会发现自己处于这种情况。

source:
O child of \c[51]Konrath\c[0].
\c[53]Four years past\c[0], for a time I was dispatched
to serve in your country.
translation:
O 儿童 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0].
\c[53]四年过去了\c[0]我曾经被派去
在你的国家服役

source:
However, thy villainous father did not bring me in. 
Me, with my lance arm unparalleled in this world.
translation:
然而,你邪恶的父亲没有带我进来。 
我,用我的剑臂 在这个世界上无与伦比。

source: That man, that time, chose wrong.
translation: 那个男人,那个时候,选错了

source:
I saw it in a knight's almanac in the kingdom's library,
but \c[51]Aerdou\c[0], you've served in a lot of
different kingdoms, huh?
translation:
我在王国图书馆的骑士传说中看到过
不过 \c[51]奥尔杜\c[0]你曾经做过很多
不同的王国,是吧?

source:
That is correct. There is no other knight to
have such achievements to his name
in such a variety of lands.
translation:
这是正确的。 没有别的骑士了
有这样的成就 他的名字

translation:
这个灾难性的光芒,转过来
所有的活物之前 它变成白色的灰烬...
甚至现在都到达了更远的东部。

source:
That light now approaches our castle.
Our world will soon be in ruins.
translation:
光线正接近我们的城堡
我们的世界很快将陷入废墟。

source:
Hero, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], we can delay no longer.
We wish you to head east forthwith,
to slay the \c[52]Envoy of Calamity\c[0], the Fallen Angel \c[51]Alma\c[0]!
translation:
英雄们 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我们不能再拖延了
我们希望你能马上往东走
来杀死 \c[52]灾害问题特使\c[0]堕落天使 \c[51]阿尔马\c[0]!

source: Oh \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], we entrust it to you!

Hey there! Somehow or other,
I've ended up as your caretaker, but...
translation:
顿! 不知为何
我成了你的守护者,但是...

source:
If I knew this was gonna happen,
I would've found a husband in the forest,
gotten married, and lived in peace!
translation:
如果我知道会发生这种事
我会在森林里找个丈夫
结婚,和平地生活!

source:
Haha! Jokes aside, don't you have a couple of friends
who live to the north and south of castle?
translation:
哈哈! 来! 哈哈! 别开玩笑了,你没几个朋友吗?
谁住在城堡的北部和南部?

source:
If you go now, you just might
be able to save one of them.
translation:
如果你现在走,你可能会
能够拯救其中之一。

source:
And on top of that, they may even join us
and lend a hand on our mission!
translation:
此外,他们甚至可能加入我们
帮我们完成任务!

source:
But...
The \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] is closing in,
so we don't have time to reach \c[53]both\c[0].
translation:
不过...
缩略语 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0] 正在接近中,
所以我们没有时间了 \c[53]两者\c[0].

source: If we can, we'll only be able to reach one.
translation: 如果我们能够,我们只能达到一个。

source: It's up to you to choose!

Gotcha! Jokes aside,
it's gonna be a tough journey,
but let's give it all we've got!!
translation:
抓到你们了! 开个玩笑
这会是一个艰难的旅程,
但是,让我们给它我们的一切!

\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
堕落天使 \c[51]阿尔马\c[0] 就在附近! 那边!

source:
Are you ready to fight?
We gotta watch our step from here on!!
translation:
你准备好战斗了吗?
我们从这里开始要小心脚步!

原来如此
你这样子 \c[51]康拉特国王\c[0]孩子们 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
I fail to see why you are without
clothing, but...
translation:
我不明白为什么你没有
衣服,不过...

source:
I offer you my congratulations for managing
to make it this far. But did you really think
you could put an end to this calamity?
translation:
我祝贺你们成功
走到这么远 但你真的认为
你能结束这场灾难吗?

source:
If you wish to stop the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0],
you'll have to defeat me.
translation:
如果你想停止的话 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0],
你必须打败我

source:
I, the Fallen Angel \c[51]Alma\c[0], will do you the honor
of testing your strength!
translation:
我,堕落天使 \c[51]阿尔马\c[0]将为你荣耀
考验你的力量!

source:
I'd love to stay and continue,
but my mission to destroy this realm takes precedence...
translation:
我很想留下来 继续
但我摧毁这个王国的使命优先...

source:
Ugh...
I underestimated this naked pervert.
You can really handle yourself.
translation:
额...
我低估了这个裸体变态
你真的可以处理好自己。

source:
I'd love to stay and finish you off,
but my mission to destroy this realm takes precedence...
translation:
我很想留下来把你干掉
但我摧毁这个王国的使命优先...

source: I will spare you this time.

\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], we meet again...
Undaunted, you mean to challenge me once more?
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我们又见面了
毫不畏惧,你又想挑战我吗?

source:
Well then...
This time I will face you as a serious opponent!
Today I will end your pitiful struggle!
translation:
那麽...
这次我要把你当成真正的对手
今天我要结束你可悲的斗争!

source:
Ugh...
How could a mere human give me such a fight...?
translation:
额...
一个普通人怎么能给我这样的战斗?

source:
Ugh...
How could a human, what's more, a pervert like this,
give me such a fight...?
translation:
额...
人类怎么会 更何况 像这样的变态
给我这样的战斗?

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], we will postpone this match.
But next time, I will utterly destroy you!
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我们推迟比赛
但下次我会彻底摧毁你!

source:
What was that?
Did you think such tricks would work on me?
translation:
那是什么声音?
你觉得这种把戏对我有用吗?

source:
How revolting...
In return I will reduce you to cinders...
translation:
多么令人厌恶...
作为回报,我会减少你 灰尘...

source:
Ugh...
Did you think that would work on me,
who was once an angel?
translation:
额...
你觉得这样对我有用吗?
谁曾经是天使?

source:
How disgusting!
I have decided... Hero, and you, fairy!
I will leave no trace of you in this world!
translation:
真恶心!
我决定... 英雄,还有你,仙女!
我不会留下任何痕迹 在这个世界中你!

呜呜呜!
她真的疯了!

source:
Ugh... Th-This feeling...
Ah... What might this be?
translation:
额... 那种感觉...
摆... 这是什么?

source:
This is...
It's like my soul is being wiped clean.
translation:
这是...
就像我的灵魂被抹去一样

source:
This must be...
It's because of you, isn't it?
translation:
这一定是...
是因为你,不是吗?

source:
I am \c[51]Alma\c[0].
An angel who sinned, and was cast from
the heavens into the lower realms.
translation:
我是 \c[51]阿尔马\c[0].
一个有罪的天使 被抛下
诸天进入下层。

source:
The grudge I have carried until now...
Together with \c[51]Pluton\c[0],
I sought to destroy this world \c[52]Creatoire\c[0] made.
translation:
我至今所怀的怨恨...
与 \c[51]冥王星\c[0],
我试图毁灭这个世界 \c[52]创建器\c[0] 已经做了。

source:
But now... It feels like
I was but trapped in a long nightmare.
translation:
但是现在... 感觉就像
我被困在一个漫长的噩梦中

source:
Whatever my grudge may have been...
I can no longer bring myself to exterminate
the innocent people of this world.
translation:
不管我的怨恨是什么...
我无法再自寻死路
这个世界的无辜人民

source:
Ahh... How can I make up for
the crimes I have committed?
translation:
摆... 我怎样才能弥补
我犯过什么罪?

source:
You can start by telling us what we can do
about that awful \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]!
translation:
你可以先告诉我们我们能做什么
关于那个可怕的 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]!

source:
If you don't, this world
is still gonna be wiped out!
translation:
如果你不这样做,这个世界
仍然会被消灭!

source:
Th-That is true...
There is no way to save this world
but to destroy the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0].
translation:
这是真的...
没有办法拯救这个世界
却摧毁了 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0].

source:
The true form of the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]...
Is a giant called \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0], a monster
forged over aeons by \c[51]Pluton\c[0].
translation:
真正的形式 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]...
是一个巨人叫 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0]一个怪物
伪造的经文 \c[51]冥王星\c[0].

source:
To attack \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0],
deep within the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]...
translation:
攻击 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0],
内心深处 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]...

source:
You must pierce the wall of light
that stands in the way.
translation:
你必须穿透光墙
挡住路了

source:
There may be a weapon in this land
capable of surmounting that powerful barrier...
translation:
这片土地上可能有武器
能够克服强大的屏障...

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
Please let me join you on this journey.
Together, I know we can destroy the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]...
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
请让我与你们一起踏上这段旅程
一起,我知道我们可以摧毁 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]...

source:
Let us destroy my... No...
\c[51]Pluton\c[0]'s servant \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0]!
translation:
让我们摧毁我的... 没有...
\c[51]冥王星\c[0]仆人 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0]!

source:
For you to accept me,
who sought to destroy this world...
translation:
为了让你接受我
他试图毁灭这个世界...
堕落天使 \c[51]阿尔马\c[0] 已经加入你们了!

source:
I, who sought to destroy this world. Yes...
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], I know you've made the right decision.
translation:
我,试图毁灭这个世界。 对...
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我知道你做了正确的决定

source:
I will take my leave here...
For now, I must gather the resolve,
to strike at \c[51]Pluton\c[0] alone...
translation:
我会离开这儿...
现在,我必须拿出决心,
罢工时间 \c[51]冥王星\c[0] 一个人...

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], thank you
for accepting me into your party.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]谢谢
接受我加入你的派对

source:
I will tell you everything I know.
Please ask me any questions you may have.
translation:
我会告诉你我知道的一切
请问任何问题

source:
\c[51]Pluton\c[0]...
He seeks the destruction of this world.
translation:
\c[51]冥王星\c[0]...
他寻求毁灭这个世界

source:
His power level with \c[52]Creatoire\c[0],
and it is he who made \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0].
translation:
他的功率水平与 \c[52]创建器\c[0],
他就是创造者, \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0].

source:
It seems that, like me, he was
banished from the heavens for a grave sin.
translation:
似乎,像我一样,他是
被从天上驱赶 以罪过。

source:
My apologies...
I cannot clearly remember, but I believe...
he violated the "mandate of the heavens."
translation:
对不起...
我记不清了,但我相信...
他违反了"天命"

source:
The true form of the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0]...
It is the giant \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0], a monster
forged by \c[51]Pluton\c[0].
translation:
真正的形式 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0]...
是那个巨人 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0]一个怪物
伪造 \c[51]冥王星\c[0].

source:
All life touched by the light
has been reduced to white ash.
translation:
光线触动了所有生命
变成了白灰

source:
Until now, my heart was connected
to that of \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0],
so I was able to control him...
translation:
直到现在,我的心是相连的
至 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0],
所以我能够控制他...

source:
But when the evil was purged from my soul,
it seems he was released from my control.
translation:
但当恶魔从我的灵魂中消失的时候,
他似乎从我的控制之下被释放了

source:
Now...
The only way to stop this
is to defeat him.
translation:
现在...
阻止这一切的唯一办法
就是要打败他

source: The crime I committed in the heavens...

Before my soul was purified, I felt like
every moment was filled with hatred, but why...
translation:
在我的灵魂被净化之前,我觉得
每一刻都充满仇恨 但为什么...

source:
I see. If you change your mind,
please do not hesitate to speak to me.
translation:
原来如此 如果你改变主意
请不要犹豫 跟我说话。

source:
Do I look unwell?
My apologies...
translation:
我看起来不舒服吗?
对不起...

source:
It seems I am still somewhat disoriented
by the sudden change in my circumstances.
translation:
看来我还是有点迷茫
我的情况突然变了

source:
There are times...
When I can't seem to stop trembling...
translation:
有的时候...
当我无法停止颤抖...

source:
For some reason, when you take my hand...
It makes me feel so calm...
translation:
出于某种原因 当你牵着我的手...
这让我感到很平静...

对... 我也不再颤抖了
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]...

source:
If it is to slay \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0],
I give all of me...to you.
translation:
如果是为了杀人 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0],
我把我的全部... 交给你

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
Well...recently, there are times
I feel a stinging pain within my chest...
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
嗯... 最近,有的时候
我胸口有刺痛的疼痛...

source:
Especially like now,
when you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], are close,
it grows stronger.
translation:
特别是现在
当你, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]就差一点了
它越来越强大。

source: Could this be a serious illness?
translation: 这会不会是严重的疾病?

source:
Though I have joined you on this
journey to help you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]...
If I collapse here, then it has all been for naught.
translation:
虽然我加入你们
为帮助你们而旅行, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]...
如果我在这里倒塌,那一切都是白费了。

source:
We will have to cure it
as soon as possible.
translation:
我们一定要治好它
尽快

source:
Urgh...
The pain has not yet healed...
translation:
额...
痛苦还没有愈合...

source:
Recently it feels like my head hurts and I have a fever...
the symptoms definitely feel stronger when you are
close, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
translation:
最近我头痛,发烧...
症状肯定更强烈 当你是
关闭, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
I hope it's just a cold, but...
Excuse me, isn't it strange for a former angel
to be catching a cold?
translation:
我希望这只是感冒,但是...
对不起,对一个前天使来说 是不是很奇怪?
要感冒吗?

你知道吗... \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]...
最近... 有点...

source:
I think I know the cause of my symptoms. It would seem
that somehow... \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you're...
translation:
我想我知道我症状的原因 看起来
不知怎的... ... . . \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],你是个...

source:
No, actually, I won't say any more.
But, at least, it is not a terrible illness.
So you need not worry...
translation:
不,实际上,我不会再说了。
但是,至少,这不是一种可怕的疾病。
所以你不必担心...

source:
Um...
That's all I wanted to say.
translation:
额...
这就是我想说的。

source:
I must deliver vengeance upon \c[51]Pluton\c[0] myself...
That is what I believe...
Forget what I just said.
translation:
我一定要报仇 \c[51]冥王星\c[0] 我亲手...
这就是我相信的...
忘了我刚才说的话吧

source:
Sad as it is, it appears we just lack
the charisma to get her to join us.
translation:
可悲的是,我们似乎只是缺乏
魅力让她加入我们的行列

source:
O child of \c[51]Konrath\c[0].
For you, now, defeating
\c[51]Pluton\c[0] might be a real possibility.
translation:
O 儿童 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0].
对你来说,现在,击败
\c[51]冥王星\c[0] 这可能是一个真正的可能性。

source:
Do you see? \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0] was created by
\c[51]Pluton\c[0], so... If he isn't struck down as well, there
can't be true peace.
translation:
你看见了吗? \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0] 由
\c[51]冥王星\c[0]这么说... 如果他没有被击倒,在那里
不会是真正的和平。

source:
If those are your intentions,
I will open a corridor here
leading to \c[51]Pluton\c[0]'s location.
translation:
如果这是你的意图,
我在这里开一条走廊
导致 \c[51]冥王星\c[0]地点

source:
Proceed down that corridor
and slay him.
translation:
沿着走廊走
杀了他

source:
Child of \c[51]Konrath\c[0].
If you have the resolve, the time has come to
choose the path that leads to \c[51]Pluton\c[0]...
translation:
国 家 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0].
如果你有决心,现在是时候了
选择通往 \c[51]冥王星\c[0]...

source: I see! So you will face \c[51]Pluton\c[0]!
translation: 原来如此! 所以你会面对 \c[51]冥王星\c[0]!

source:
Child of \c[51]Konrath\c[0].
The path may be challenging, but I believe in you.
translation:
国 家 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0].
这条路也许有挑战性 但我相信你

source:
I see. If you change your mind,
visit me again.
translation:
原来如此 如果你改变主意
再来一次

source:
Child of \c[51]Konrath\c[0].
Are you now prepared to slay \c[51]Pluton\c[0]?
translation:
国 家 \c[51]康拉特语Name\c[0].
你现在准备杀人了吗? \c[51]冥王星\c[0]?

source:
I am known by the name \c[51]Pluton\c[0].
I am the destroyer of a multitude of worlds.
translation:
我以这个名字而闻名 \c[51]冥王星\c[0].
我是众多世界的毁灭者

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
so you were guided here by her...

Unlike my puppet, it seems you
possess some small spark of potential.
translation:
不像我的傀儡,好像是你
拥有一些微小的潜力火花

source:
Be that is it may, it was a mistake to come here.
I will not abide a mere puppet such as you
standing in my way any longer.
translation:
可能吧,来这里是错的
我不会忍受像你这样的傀儡
挡住我的路了

source: So I will put an end to you myself.

Do you now doubt yourself? If you cannot defeat me,
this world will know an eternity of chaos.
translation:
你现在怀疑自己了吗? 如果你不能打败我
这个世界会永远混乱

source:
Come, then! I will break you and make her taste
true horror!
translation:
来啊! 我会打碎你,让她尝尝
真正的恐怖！

source:
When I compare you to my puppet, who
betrayed me and chose the likes of you...
I created quite the disappointment.
translation:
当我把你和我的傀儡比起来时
背叛了我 选择了你这种人
我制造了相当的失望。

source:
Together with \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
who freed me from your sorcery, I will destroy you!
Prepare yourself.
translation:
与 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
谁把我从你的巫术中解救出来,我必毁灭你!
准备好吧

source:
Hmph.
Grand posturing from my own trash.
translation:
Hmph.
从我自己的垃圾堆里大展身手

source:
Be that is it may, for you to come here...
I will not abide mere puppets such as you
standing in my way any longer.
translation:
如果是这样的话,你来这里...
我不会像你们这样的傀儡
挡住我的路了

source:
Come, then! I will break you and make her taste
true horror!
translation:
来啊! 我会打碎你,让她尝尝
真正的恐怖！

source:
Me, a god...
Defeated by a thing of \c[51]Creatoire\c[0]'s making...
translation:
我,一个神...
被一个东西击败 \c[51]创建器\c[0]正在制造...

source:
Bwahahaha...
HAH HAH HAH HAH Hahahaha!!
translation:
华哈哈...
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!

source:
To be defeated by a thing of \c[51]Creatoire\c[0]'s making...
And a toy of my own!
translation:
被一个东西打败 \c[51]创建器\c[0]正在制造...
还有我自己的玩具!

source:
You certainly are my masterpiece!
Ha, haha! HAH HAH HAH HAH Hahahahahaha...
translation:
你当然是我的杰作!
哈,哈,哈,哈! 来,来! HAH HAH HAH HAH Hahahahahaha...

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you have returned.
Very well...

For my profit, you will die!

对不起,朋友。
为了我的利益,你会死的!
