Are you okay?
All right, don't overdo it.
translation:
你没事吧?
好吧,不要过份。

source:
<TARGET>,
polishing a sword,
spoke with a worried look.
translation:
<TARGET>,
擦剑
说话时很担心

source:
You're choosing crime
while the world is like this...
translation:
你选择的是犯罪
当世界是这样的时候...

source: Can you endure my blade's edge?

How you doing??
Let's give it our all!
translation:
你好吗?
让我们全力以赴!

source:
<TARGET>
is running around
full of energy.
translation:
<TARGET>
四处奔跑
充满能量。

source:
Wh, what is it?
It's not like I was looking at you!
translation:
什么,这是什么?
我不是在看着你!

<TARGET>
眼睁睁地看着 令人尴尬的。

source:
That's a positive ID!
A mimic has appeared!
translation:
这是肯定的身份证!
模仿出现了!

source:
That's a positive ID! A mimic has
emerged from the box!
translation:
这是肯定的身份证! 一个模仿者
从盒子里出来!
戈巴哥巴! 戈巴哥巴!

<TARGET> 乱动的骨头
充满热情。

source:
With each step, a piece of
<TARGET>'s rotten body
falls off.
translation:
每一步 一块
<TARGET>腐烂的身体
掉下来了

source:
W-What?!
I-It's not like I was thinking
about you...or anything!
translation:
什麽?
我 - 这不是我在想什么
关于你... 或任何东西!

source:
With that, <TARGET>'s
face grew beet red.
translation:
有了这个 <TARGET>编号(_A):
脸红了

source:
I'm getting too old for this...
I should probably retire when
we're done.
translation:
我太老了,这...
我大概应该退休的时候
我们完了

source:
You, you monster... No, could it be
you're a traveler? Sorry about that.
I can see you bear no hostility now.
translation:
你这个怪物... 不会吧?
你是旅行者吗? 对不起。
我看得出你现在没有敌意

source:
This area is the border between
two areas.
translation:
这个区域是
两个方面。

source:
I believe this area ends
after \c[52]$tmp1km\c[0].
translation:
我相信这个区域会结束
之后 \c[52]$tmp1km\c[0].

source:
I haven't been to the next area,
so I don't know how long it goes
on for. Stay well.
translation:
我没去过下个区域
所以我不知道它会持续多久
开始 保持良好的状态。

source:
The next area goes on for... \c[52]$tmp2km\c[0],
I believe. Well then, take care.
translation:
下一个区域继续... \c[52]$tmp2km\c[0],
相信吗? 那么, 小心点.

source:
No matter where,
I'll fly with you!
translation:
无论在哪里,
我和你一起飞!

<TARGET> 快乐地欢呼,
这边看

source:
<TARGET> is almost flying,
splashing enthusiastically
in the water.
translation:
<TARGET> 几乎飞起来了
热情地飘荡
在水中。

C -C -赵!
不可思议的混乱!

source:
<TARGET> sings vigorously.
But honestly isn't very good...
translation:
<TARGET> 大力唱歌。
但说实话,这不太好...

source:
<TARGET> is sparkling.
Th-That's a little too bright...
translation:
<TARGET> 闪闪发光
这有点太明亮了...

source:
<TARGET>'s ablaze.
It's so hot you can't get near.
translation:
<TARGET>烧着了
太热了,你不能靠近。

source:
Blinding light reflects off 
<TARGET> and you avert your eyes.
translation:
闪光反射 
<TARGET> 你却避开你的眼睛

source:
<TARGET> seems to be
laughing, but you can't quite
make out where from.
translation:
<TARGET> 似乎有点...
笑,但你无法完全
弄清楚从哪来

<TARGET> 开心的
对你发牢骚

source:
Wow, what a pretty lady!
Lady, are you a princess?
Luckyyyy, I wanna be a princess too!
translation:
哇,多么美丽的女士!
小姐,你是公主吗?
Luckyyy,我也想当公主!

source:
Princess, do you know the "Forest
Guardians"? They're a radical nature
group that hunts poachers.
translation:
公主,你知道森林吗?
守护者? 他们是激进的天性
猎捕偷猎者的团体

source:
So, no hunting animals
that don't attack you.
translation:
所以,没有猎物
那不会攻击你。

source:
The "Forest Guardians" show no
mercy to poachers. ...I wonder if they
would spare even a princess...
translation:
"森林守护者"显示没有
怜悯偷猎者 ...我想知道他们是否
哪怕是公主也会...

source:
Hellooo!
Hey, hey, do you know of the
"Forest Guardians"?
translation:
哈罗!
嘿,嘿,你知道
"森林守护者"?

source:
They're a radical nature group
that hunts poachers.
translation:
他们是一个激进的自然团体
猎杀偷猎者。

source:
So, no hunting animals
that don't attack you.
translation:
所以,没有猎物
那不会攻击你。

source:
The "Forest Guardians" show no
mercy to poachers. Careful, or
you'll get poached yourself.
translation:
"森林守护者"显示没有
怜悯偷猎者 小心点,或者
你会被偷的

source:
Watch your back 
or I might hijack you... hehe
translation:
小心点 
或者我可能会劫持你... 哈啰

source:
<TARGET> seemed
to be grinning from ear to ear.

Whoa... I thought you were a monster
that got into the castle, but it's just
\c[50]\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]\c[0]! Ha, sorry about that.
translation:
珃瓳... 我还以为你是个怪物
进入城堡,但它只是
\c[50]\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]\c[0]! 哈,对不起。

source:
Oh! Queen!
So at last you will embark on
your journey!
translation:
瓳! 奎恩! 奎恩! 盖尔!
你终于可以开始了
你的旅程! 来!

source:
I don't suppose you've forgotten
the fundamentals of battle from
our classes?
translation:
我想你没忘记吧
战争的基本要素
我们的课?

source:
Swordsmen boast high attack power,
and compared to other classes often
slay enemies with a single blow.
translation:
武士们高超的进攻力
与其他班级相比
用一击就杀死敌人

source:
With a high maximum WT limit, it's an
easy to use class! Obviously the
sword is their specialty.
translation:
WT最高限值是
容易上课! 很明显
剑是他们的专长

source:
A Knight's strong defense is their 
appeal. With healing items they 
can rush to face the Fallen Angel.
translation:
骑士的强力防御是他们的 
上诉。 他们用治疗用的东西 
能够匆忙面对堕落天使

source:
And the fact that they can survive
while surrounded by enemies
is also appealing.
translation:
和他们能够生存的事实
被敌人包围
也具有吸引力。

source:
Shields are twice as effective.
Watch the durability so it
doesn't break when you need it.
translation:
盾牌是两倍的有效。
注意耐久性,所以它
需要的时候不会坏掉

source:
Archers are a class renowned for
superior bowmanship. Enemy
detection is another of their appeals.
translation:
弓箭手是一门著名的课程
高贵的鞠躬。 敌人
侦察是他们的另一个呼吁。

source:
Run to maintain distance and
take down enemies with
high-precision ranged attacks.
translation:
运行以保持距离
击败敌人
高度精准的攻击范围。

source:
This class has great attack
and evasion. But as a jack of 
all trades, you're master of none.
translation:
这门课很厉害
和逃避。 但作为一J 
所有的行业,你是无能的主人

source:
However, if you develop your abilities,
you will find yourself learning useful
thief-like skills.
translation:
但是,如果你发展你的能力,
你会发现自己学习有用
偷东西一样的技巧

source:
Sorcerers are a class that can learn
new Force powers anywhere, as long
as they have the levels to use.
translation:
巫师是一个可以学习的班
新的力量力量 任何地方,只要
因为他们有 使用的水平。

source:
The number of Force powers that
you can learn is limited. So it may be
difficult to choose what to learn.
translation:
强制权力的数量
你可以学习是有限的。 也许是
很难选择学习什么。

source:
To use certain Force powers,
you must "concentrate." So
you will need to think one step ahead.
translation:
为了使用某些力量
你必须"集中。"所以
你需要先想一想

source:
Pirates are a class that specializes in
moving and fighting in water. So they
aren't intimidated by coastal areas.
translation:
海盗是一门专业
在水中移动和战斗。 所以他们
没有被沿海地区吓倒。

source:
When facing strong enemies other
than sea creatures and flyers, they
can retreat through bodies of water!
translation:
当面对敌人时
比海洋生物和传单,他们
能够从水中撤退!

source:
The Adventurer's appeal is that they
have good movement abilities!
Swimming and climbing are easy.
translation:
冒险家的吸引力是
有良好的行动能力!
游泳和爬山很容易

source:
They can \c[52]pick locks\c[0] from the start,
so an adventurer can attempt getting
even dangerous treasures early on.
translation:
他们可以 \c[52]开锁\c[0] 从一开始,
这样冒险家就可以尝试得到
甚至很早就有危险的宝藏了

source:
Half-Beasts are born with high HP
and ST, and quickly develop agility.
But, they're weak with the Force.
translation:
半野兽出生时的HP含量很高
和ST, 并迅速发展敏捷。
但是,他们弱与原力。

source:
With the best night vision,
they rarely fall victim to surprise
attacks while moving at night.
translation:
用最好的夜视镜,
他们很少被吓到
在夜间移动时攻击。

source:
Rangers are a class specializing in
moving over mountains
and they possess the Lockpick skill.
translation:
游骑兵是一门专业课程
在山上移动
他们拥有洛克挑剔的技能。

source:
They are not suited to head-on
combat...but they are somewhat
good at fighting animals.
translation:
他们不适合正面行动
战斗... 但他们有点...
擅长打动物

source:
Rangers also do not get food
poisoning from eating spoiled food.
They are good at long distance travel.
translation:
游骑兵也得不到食物
食用被宠坏的食物中毒
他们很擅长长途旅行

source:
Gunners, as their name suggests, are
a class skilled with guns. You need
a gun equipped to use their skills.
translation:
枪手们,如他们的名字所示,
一个精通枪械的班级 你需要的
一支装备精良的枪

source:
They can also craft guns.
Your firearm will determine your
victory or defeat.
translation:
他们还可以制造枪械。
你的枪将决定你
胜利或失败。

source:
Heroes are powerful but they're weak
to side and rear attacks.
Don't let enemies in your blind spots!
translation:
英雄是强者,但弱者
侧面和后方攻击。
不要让敌人进入你的盲点!

source:
If you reach \c[52]level 3\c[0],
they say you can learn a legendary
spell, but...
translation:
如果你达到 \c[52]职等 3\c[0],
他们说你可以学传奇
拼写,但是...

source:
The Assassin's appeal lies in the fact
that with high Agility and Attack,
they possess a wide variety of skills.
translation:
刺客的吸引力在于
以高明的敏锐和进攻的声望,
他们拥有各种各样的技能。

source:
Their skills require great resources
so using them with discretion 
is the key to victory.
translation:
他们的技能需要大量资源
所以,谨慎使用它们 
是胜利的关键。

source:
Dark Knights have high starting
parameters, and excellent defense.
translation:
黑暗骑士们有高端开始
参数, 和出色的防御。

source:
There are downsides to their skills,
but in 1 on 1 they are powerful. You
need to pick your battles or else.
translation:
他们的技能有缺陷,
内 1 开 开 1 他们很强大。 你个...
需要选择你的战斗 否则。

source:
They excel in melee combat, except
with swords, the weapon of the crown.
This class has fallen from grace.
translation:
他们最擅长的就是轻柔的战斗
用剑,皇冠的武器。
这门课从恩典上掉下来了

source:
Brawlers are gifted pugilists,
so their bare-fisted abilities
are second to none.
translation:
布朗勒斯是天才游手好闲的人
所以他们赤裸裸的能力
是次于零的。

source:
The skill Unity of Spirit hits like
a ton of bricks. Their muscles 
make difficult terrain easy.
translation:
精神的团结就像
一吨砖头。 他们的肌肉 
地势很困难

source:
However, they struggle with
weapons and armor doesn't
fit them well either.
translation:
然而,他们却与
武器和盔甲没有
也适合他们。

source:
Priests practice the art of healing.
Compared to Sorcerers, they lack
firepower, but can use healing Forces.
translation:
祭司练习治疗的艺术。
与巫师相比,他们缺少
火力,但可以使用 愈合力量。

source:
Considering that they can't use
offensive arts at first, caution is
recommended at the beginning.
translation:
考虑到他们不能使用
一开始是进攻性艺术 谨慎就是
最初建议。

source:
Undead have disproportionately
strong offensive arts,
and special undead skills.
translation:
亡灵有不相称
强烈的进攻性艺术,
和特殊不死技能。

source:
...that said, Zombies, compared to
other classes, are emaciated.
If you see a strong enemy, flee.
translation:
和僵尸相比
其他课程, 消化。
如果你看到一个强大的敌人, 逃跑。

source:
Although they have high HP, they are
weak against flames, so battling
the Fallen Angel is dangerous.
translation:
虽然他们有高HP,他们是
无力对抗火焰,如此争斗
堕落天使是危险的。

source:
If you somehow gain levels,
and can learn skills, then just maybe...
translation:
如果你得到什么水平,
并且可以学习技能, 然后只是也许...

source:
Queens, as a class... Well. Their
strong point is that they are born
with incredible charisma.
translation:
皇后区,作为一个类... 这个嘛 他们的
强点是他们出生了
魅力无比

source:
Use that charisma to build
your personal army.
Always equip a human shield.
translation:
利用魅力来构建
你的私人军队
总是装备人盾。

source:
It seems they're not good against
undead. Too scary? That's cute...
Er, I humbly apologize.
translation:
看来他们不是好对手
还没死 太吓人了? 真可爱...
呃,我谦卑地道歉。

source:
About Astrologists, yeah.
Among sorcerers, they are
specialists in detection.
translation:
关于星座学家,是的。
在术士中,他们是
探测专家

source:
They can locate all points on a map.
Their identification is unequalled,
and they gain detection arts cheaply.
translation:
他们可以在地图上找到所有点
他们的身份被否定了
并且他们以廉价的方式获得发现艺术。

source:
Samurai have great strength at
the brink of death, so if their HP falls
below 25%, they fight even better.
translation:
武士武士有很强的力量
死亡的边缘,所以如果他们的HP下降
下图 25%,他们甚至打得更好。

source:
Also, the Lone Slash they learn
at level 12 is weak at first, but I hear
it gets more powerful as it's used.
translation:
还有,他们学会了孤独的鞭笞
职等 12 一开始很虚弱,但我听说了
它的威力随着它的使用而增加

source:
Beast Hunters specialize in fighting
rare monsters. They deal heavy
damage against strong, large enemies.
translation:
野兽猎人擅长打斗
稀有的怪兽 卖的很重
对强大的敌人造成伤害

source:
It seems they are good with swords
and fist weapons. Force and long
distance weapons are not their forte.
translation:
似乎他们用剑很厉害
和拳头武器。 力和长
远距武器不是他们的先锋。

source:
They have strong rear defense
like a knight, but unlike a
knight, no shield bonus.
translation:
他们有强大的后防力
像骑士,但不像一个
骑士,没有盾牌奖金。

source:
The extra damage they deal
to dragons will help as
your adventure looms long.
translation:
他们处理的额外损害
龙会帮助
你的冒险期很长

source:
The Wrestler's specialty is that
they can survive with just one HP.
This is helpful against heavy blows.
translation:
摔跤手的专长是
只有一个HP就能活下来
这对打击重击很有帮助。

source:
You can't equip everything, but with
a superior WT limit, you can travel
around with a good item collection.
translation:
你无法装备一切,但用
高级 WT 限制, 您可以旅行
周围有一个很好的物品收藏。

source:
The level 12 skill Palm Thrust
improves with use and also
knocks enemies back.
translation:
级别 12 手掌推进器
使用改进,以及
击退敌人

source:
They also learn temporary
self-buffs. These mighty skills
are for short fights.
translation:
她们还学习临时学习
自我打击 这些绝妙的技巧
是短打。

source:
They are adept at using all types of
weapons, but they suffer penalties
when they are not fully equipped.
translation:
他们善于使用所有类型的
武器,但他们要受到惩罚
当他们没有完全装备的时候,

source:
Hrm? This person,
no... It must be my imagination.
translation:
怎么样? Hrm? 这个人
没有... 这一定是我的想象力

source:
Hey hey! What are you doing
dressed like that?
translation:
喂，喂！ 你这是干什么?
穿成这样?

source: Take a load off, will ya?
H-hey, put on some damned clothes!

You scoundrel! If you've come to
disturb the peace of this land
I'll show you no mercy!
translation:
你这个无赖! 如果你来了
扰乱这片土地的安宁
我绝对不会放过你!

source:
My goodness, your highness.
Is this an inspection? You must
be weary from traveling so far.
translation:
我的老天爷,陛下
这是检查吗? 你必须
旅行到现在都已经疲倦了

source:
I am part of the garrison here.
I protect the peace of this land.
I'll expel any criminals, leave it to me.
translation:
我是这里的驻军成员
我保护这片土地的和平
我会开除任何罪犯 交给我吧

source:
I am part of the garrison, my duty is
protecting the peace here.
translation:
我是驻军的一部分,我的职责是
保护这里的和平

source:
And I drive out those who commit
crimes. That's my job.
translation:
我将犯罪的人驱逐出去,
罪行。 犯罪。 这是我的工作。

source:
Huh? That person,
no...am I imagining it?
translation:
是吗? 那个人
没有... 我是不是在想象呢?

阿克! 亚克!
...你完全裸体吗?

乌华? (灌木丛)
...你... 裸体吗?

source: You've done well to make it this far.
translation: 你做得很好 已经走到了这么远。

source: Take your time before you go.

Aaaaggghh, put on some clothes...
Come on!
I don't even know where to look!!
translation:
穿点衣服...
来吧!
我甚至不知道该去哪里找!

source:
Whoa... Is that look
in right now or something?
translation:
珃瓳... 是这样吗?
现在还是什么?

source:
Hey you, I don't trust you!
What's your business here?!
translation:
嘿,你,我不相信你! 我不信你,我不相信你,我不相信你,我不相信你!
你在这里做什么?

source:
Your highness, it is an honor to
meet you. I serve in the garrison here.
Please, be at ease and rest yourself.
translation:
陛下,我很荣幸
见到你。 我在这里的驻军服役
请放松 休息吧

source:
I am the garrison here, I hope
that you have no ill intentions.
translation:
我是这里的驻军,我希望
你没有恶意

source:
Peace is everything.
Relax and rest up.
translation:
和平是一切。
放松,休息一会。

啊,一个邪恶的恶魔...
停下来!

source:
The Dream Vault is...
Only for heroes...
...Go away.
translation:
梦之洞是...
只为英雄们...
走开

source:
...The Dream Vault...
You can't open it here...
translation:
...梦之洞...

\c[52]Staves\c[0] are light, durable, boost Force
and some give a Concentration bonus.
Sorcerers take note!
translation:
\c[52]钉子\c[0] 是光,耐久,助推力
有些人会给集中奖金。
巫师会注意的!

source:
\c[52]Knuckles\c[0] have high combo rates
and if you KO an enemy, remaining
attacks hit surrounding foes.
translation:
\c[52]括号\c[0] 组合率高
如果你们是敌人,那末,你们应当是敌人,
袭击了周围的敌人

source:
The \c[52]bow\c[0] is a long range weapon
that increases the range and strength
of arrows. It only works with arrows.
translation:
缩略语 \c[52]弓\c[0] 是一种长程武器
增加射程和强度
箭头 它只使用箭头。

source:
The \c[52]gun\c[0], also long range, is a
weapon that can use Force to fire a
piercing attack in a straight line.
translation:
缩略语 \c[52]枪\c[0],也是远距离的,是
使用武力发射武器
直线刺穿攻击

source:
\c[52]Boomerangs\c[0] have low power,
but can go through walls and hit
enemies in an arc.
translation:
\c[52]潮人\c[0] 有低功率,
但能穿过墙撞到
敌人在弧线。

source:
It seems there are other special
weapons, but these are the main
types.
translation:
好像还有其他特别的东西
武器,但这些是主要的
类型。

source:
Weapons are for attack, armor for
protection, but \c[52]accessories\c[0] are
equipped for many purposes.
translation:
武器是用来攻击的,盔甲是用来
保护,但 \c[52]附件\c[0] 是
装备有多种用途。

source:
\c[52]Shields\c[0], which increase defensive
performance, have endurance like
weapons and armor.
translation:
\c[52]盾牌\c[0],这增加了防御
表演,有耐力喜欢
武器和盔甲

source:
If you want to reduce damage taken,
you might want to equip one. Some
classes double their effectiveness.
translation:
如果你想减少损失
你也许想装一个 部分
班级的效能加倍。

source:
Many have high WT, so unless you're
a class that can carry a lot, you might
not be able to use one.
translation:
很多人有高WT,所以除非你
一个能带很多东西的班级,你可能会
无法使用 。

source:
If you equip \c[52]arrows\c[0] and push \my[-5]\sysS[70]\my[-5],
if there is no one to talk to, or attack
in front of you, you will fire.
translation:
如果你装备 \c[52]箭头\c[0] 并推动 \my[-5]\sysS[70]\my[-5],
如果没有人可以说话或攻击
在你面前,你会开枪。

source:
Arrows are effective against 
short range enemies, but remember
that the range is only 2 tiles.
translation:
箭头能有效对抗 
短距离敌人, 但记住
仅此范围 2 瓷砖。

source:
Pair arrows with bows.
It increases their range and damage.
translation:
有弓的对箭
它增加了它们的射程和破坏。

source:
However make sure there are no
NPCs in the way. If you hit one by
accident it can turn nasty. Take care.
translation:
不过要保证没有
国家指挥中心挡路了 如果你打中一个
意外会变坏的 小心点

source:
Additionally, the \c[52]music box\c[0] raises
allies' Morale, and \c[52]boots\c[0] have an
effect on movement.
translation:
此外, \c[52]音乐框\c[0] 调高
盟国的士气, \c[52]靴子\c[0] 来一个
对运动的影响。

source:
Also, equipping cursed accessories
can drain ST. If ST reaches 0, then
HP will be drained instead. Take care.
translation:
还有 装配被诅咒的配件
能够排出ST。 如果ST达到 0,然后,
HP将被排干。 小心点

source:
What kind of \c[52]accessories\c[0] you carry...
This is a big factor that can determine
the success or failure of your journey.
translation:
什么样的 \c[52]附件\c[0] 你背着...
这是一个大因素 可以决定
旅途的成败

source:
Now I'll teach you about attributes:
\c[52]Strength\c[0], \c[52]Agility\c[0], \c[52]Vitality\c[0], \c[52]Intelligence\c[0], 
\c[52]Willpower\c[0], \c[52]Charisma\c[0].

First, higher \c[52]Strength\c[0] improves
the performance of close and ranged
attacks. Max WT also rises bit by bit.
translation:
第一,再高一点 \c[52]强度\c[0] 改进
近距离和距离性能
攻击。 最大 WT 也位元上升 。

source:
The higher \c[52]Agility\c[0] is, the higher
your combo attack and evasion rates.
Action speed is also increased.
translation:
越高一点 \c[52]灵敏度\c[0] 是, 越高
你的组合攻击率和逃税率
行动速度也提高了。

source:
And \c[52]Vitality\c[0] reduces damage, and
speeds up natural HP regeneration.
translation:
还有 \c[52]生命力\c[0] 减少损害,
加速自然HP再生。

source:
\c[52]Willpower\c[0] improves Force and crit
rate. Some weapons effect, like guns,
are based on Willpower, not Strength.
translation:
\c[52]意志力\c[0] 改进武力和批评
费率。 一些武器效果,像枪,
以意志力而不是力量为基础

source:
Lastly, \c[52]Charisma\c[0] raises allies'
attack and decreases the cost of
items sold to you.
translation:
最后, \c[52]魅力主义a\c[0] 升起盟国。
攻击和减少
东西卖给你。

source:
To move diagonally, hold \my[-5]\sysS[75]\my[-5]
while moving.
translation:
要移动对角, 请按住 \my[-5]\sysS[75]\my[-5]
移动时。

source:
If you hold \my[-4]\sysS[73]\my[-4] while moving, you
can enter \c[52]Dash Mode\c[0] to move faster.
translation:
如果你坚持 \my[-4]\sysS[73]\my[-4] 在移动的时候,你
可以输入 \c[52]发牌模式\c[0] 移动速度更快。

source:
Vary movement speed depending on
whether you need to proceed
carefully, or can speed ahead.
translation:
变化速度取决于
是否需要继续
小心点,或者加快速度
新闻 \my[-5]\sysS[79]\my[-5] 以打开快捷键。

source:
To set or remove a \c[52]Shortcut\c[0],
press \my[-5]\sysS[74]\my[-5] to open the menu,
select an item or skill, then press \my[-5]\sysS[70]\my[-5].
translation:
要设置或删除 \c[52]快捷键\c[0],
按键 \my[-5]\sysS[74]\my[-5] 打开菜单,
选择项目或技能,然后按 \my[-5]\sysS[70]\my[-5].

source:
You can add frequently used items
and skills to shortcuts. Concentration
is a good choice for sorcerers.
translation:
您可以添加常用项目
还有捷径的技巧 浓度
这是巫师的好选择

source:
Food greatly restores \c[52]EN\c[0]. But many
things will spoil as you carry them, so
it is risky to keep them too long.
translation:
食物大为恢复 \c[52]饱食度\c[0]. 但很多东西
东西会腐烂 当你携带它们,所以
让他们呆太久是很危险的

source:
Which food spoils is random. Some
will last through an entire journey.
Others will spoil immediately.
translation:
什么样的食物是随机的。 部分
将持续整个旅程
其他人马上就会变坏的

source:
Spoiling rate depends on type of
food, like \c[52]Raw Meat\c[0], which
spoils easily.
translation:
破坏率取决于
食物,喜欢 \c[52]原生肉类\c[0],哪个
轻而易举的宠物

source:
Spoiled food gives lower EN recovery,
and also causes \c[52]Food Poisoning\c[0].
translation:
腐烂的食物能降低EN的恢复率
以及原因 \c[52]食品中毒\c[0].

source:
The more spoiled food you eat,
the worse the food poisoning,
so gorging on it is dangerous.
translation:
你吃的食物越被宠坏
食物中毒情况更严重
因此,在它上乱来是危险的。

source:
Speaking of that, if you have \c[52]Ally
NPCs\c[0] carry things, they don't rot
for some reason. I wonder why?
translation:
说到这个,如果你有 \c[52]爱丽
NPCs 国家联络中心\c[0] 带着东西,它们不会腐烂
因为某种原因 不知道为什么?

source:
The beautiful, rainbow sparkling
\c[52]Dream Stones\c[0]. If someone like
me has them, they're simple gems.
translation:
美丽的彩虹闪耀着
\c[52]梦之石\c[0]. 如果有人喜欢
我拥有它们,它们是简单的宝石。

source:
However, the hero, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
can use them to make changes
to this castle.
translation:
但是,那个英雄 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
可以用它们来修改
来到这个城堡

source:
Dream Stones can be found
anywhere. They can even bought and
sold. Monsters can also carry them.
translation:
梦之石可以找到
随便你 他们甚至可以买和
卖了 怪兽也可以携带它们。

source:
Dream Stones can also be used to get
additional \c[52]Castle Residents\c[0], who
help on your quest.
translation:
梦石也可以用来买
额外 \c[52]城堡居民\c[0]是谁?
帮助你的探险。

source:
Among these, there might also appear
some who can lead you on new
\c[52]Quests\c[0].
translation:
其中可能还包括:
有些人能带领你进入新时代
\c[52]查询\c[0].

source:
If you finish these quests,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you might
discover new possibilities.
translation:
如果你完成这些任务
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],你可能会
发现新的可能性。

source:
W-What?! A zombie in the castle?!
...Ah, \c[50]\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]\c[0], it's you.
Sorry, I don't mean to be afraid.
translation:
什麽? 城堡里的僵尸?
. . 摆, \c[50]\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]\c[0]是你吗?
对不起,我不是故意害怕的。

source:
I say, your highness!
I see that you are setting out.
My humblest advice.
translation:
我说,殿下!
我看到你要出发了
我最谦虚的建议

source:
You can get items from \c[52]Wooden
Boxes\c[0] and \c[52]Treasure Chests\c[0] by
breaking them open by attacking.
translation:
你可以从 \c[52]木质
框数\c[0] 财务报告和已审计财务报表 \c[52]宝藏胸\c[0] 缩略语
通过攻击打破它们。

source:
Also! Using the \c[52]Lockpick\c[0] skill
lets you retrieve items even 
more smoothly.
translation:
还有! 使用 \c[52]锁定选择\c[0] 技能
使您能够获取项目 
更顺利。

source:
Won't you use arms issued
to knights?
translation:
你会不会用发的军火
给骑士?

source:
Monster?! ...Er, the king's kid?
...Wha?
S-Something...happened to you.
translation:
怪兽? 国王的孩子?
……什么？
有些东西... 对你来说是件好事

source:
Anyway, how about buying weapons
off me?
I think they're pretty easy to use.
translation:
总之,买武器怎么样?
离开我?
我觉得他们很容易被使用

source:
Oh, hello your highness, and you,
fairy. I bought too much from a knight
and can't carry it all now...
translation:
哦,你好,陛下,还有你,
仙女们 我从一个骑士那里买的太多了
现在不能全部搬走...

source:
Might you have space?
Would you like to buy some off me?
I won't sell you any junk.
translation:
你有空位吗?
你想从我这里买点吗?
我不会卖给你的垃圾。

source:
Oh, hello hero, and you,
fairy. I bought too much from a knight
and can't carry it all now...
translation:
哦,你好英雄,还有你,
仙女们 我从一个骑士那里买的太多了
现在不能全部搬走...

source:
Do you have space?
How about buying a weapon off
of me? They're pretty easy to use.
translation:
你有空间吗?
不如去买件武器
对我? 它们很容易使用。

source:
Thank you.
I'll be praying for you to
safely finish your journey.
translation:
谢谢
我会为你祈祷
一路顺风

source:
Well then, on your way.
It's gonna be tough, but do your best.
translation:
那好,马上来
这会很艰难,但要尽你所能

source: Do you need some knight armor?

...So it's true that Konrath's kid
is a zombie. Er, excuse me,
Rude of me to be so nosy.
translation:
康拉特的孩子是真的
是个僵尸 对不起
我太无礼了,多管闲事

source:
I am Grande. I am a knight,
and also manage issued arms.
Do you need some equipment?
translation:
我是格兰德 我是个骑士
并管理发放的武器。
你需要一些设备吗?

source:
So your majesty shall head east.
I am Grande, a knight in your service.
I manage the castle's issued arms.
translation:
陛下将往东走
我是格朗德 为你服务的骑士
我管理城堡发放的武器

source:
I humbly offer this
equipment for you to take.
For a small fee, of course.
translation:
我谦恭地提出这个
设备,你拿。
当然是小费

source:
Setting out? I didn't recognize you,
hero. I am Grande. I am a knight,
and also manage issued arms.
translation:
准备出发? 我没认出你
英雄们 我是格兰德 我是个骑士
并管理发放的武器。

source:
How about it? If you need
this equipment, take it with you.
I will have to charge you, of course.
translation:
怎么样? 如果你需要的话
这个装备,带上吧
我当然要收你钱

source: I hope that's of some help to you.
translation: 我希望这对你有点帮助

source:
So I can't cook for you anymore,
<PLAYER>...
translation:
所以我不能再为你做饭了
<PLAYER>...

source:
Even if you are a zombie,
don't you go eating anything
that looks or smells weird.
translation:
就算你是个僵尸
你什么也别吃
看上去或闻起来怪怪的

source:
Don't you go eating anything
that looks or smells weird.
Nayuta are tasty by themselves.
translation:
你什么也别吃
看上去或闻起来怪怪的
纳尤塔自己也很好吃

source:
Ah, <PLAYER>... Even as a
zombie, you always ate my cooking.
I'll worry about your diet on the road.
translation:
摆 摆 <PLAYER>... 即使是一个
僵尸,你总是吃我的饭。
我会担心你的饮食在路上。

source:
Oh, your highness! So I won't be able
to prepare your meals until the end,
how unfortunate...
translation:
哦,陛下! 陛下! 陛下! 谢天谢地! 这样我就没法了
准备食物直到最后,
多么不幸的... . .

source:
<PLAYER>, I see you are at
last setting out. I cannot join you so
I worry about your diet on the road.
translation:
<PLAYER>, I see you are at
最后出发了 我不能加入你们
我担心你的饮食在路上。

source:
Please, take this BBQ grill with you.
With this, you can cook meat
anywhere! But it is a little heavy.
translation:
请带着这个BBQ烤架
有了这个,你就能煮肉了
随便你! 但它有点重。

source:
With that, safe travels. Avoid raw
meat as much as you can. It tastes
bad, and there's the poisoning risk.
translation:
有了它,安全的旅行。 避免生动
尽量多吃肉 味道不错
不好,还有中毒的风险。

AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
阿亚亚哈哈哈哈哈哈哈

source:
<TARGET>
shook his head
and danced happily.
translation:
<TARGET>
摇头
并快乐地跳舞。

source:
If you're going on a journey, don't
you need medicine? Won't you
stop by my place?
translation:
如果你要去旅行,别去
你需要药吗? 你不会吗?
去我家吗?

source:
Hey, <PLAYER>, I'm sad to
see you go. I really liked you. A
zombie I can test on is hard to find...
translation:
顿 <PLAYER>, I'm sad to
看你离开。 我真的很喜欢你 A 级
我能测试的僵尸很难找到

source:
...Ahem!
By the way, I've got a lot of extra
potions, why not take some with you?
translation:
额!
顺便说一句,我有很多额外的
药水,为什么不 采取一些与你?

source:
Oh, queen, you look well.
I pray for your successful journey
free of incident.
translation:
哦,女王,你看起来不错。
我祈祷你的旅途成功
避免发生意外。

source:
Also, won't you please consider
taking my medicine with you?
It's just, I made a little too much.
translation:
还有,你能不能考虑一下
带上我的药?
只是,我做得太过头了

source:
Oh, <PLAYER>, you're going?
By the way, I've got a lot of extra
potions, why not take some with you?
translation:
瓳 <PLAYER>你要走了吗?
顺便说一句,我有很多额外的
药水,为什么不 采取一些与你?

source:
What, there's nothing odd today.
Anything that might explode, or set
everything on fire, I'll keep for myself.
translation:
今天没什么奇怪的事
任何可能爆炸,或设置
所有东西着火了,我自己留着

source:
Well, I've got to set out as well. I
wanted to keep working in the
castle, but Shine Raid is coming...
translation:
我也得出发了 页:1
想要继续工作在
城堡,但Shine Raid来了...

source:
There are still potions I haven't
tested... I mean, there are still people
in the world I can heal! See ya!
translation:
还有一些药水，我尚未
测试... 我的意思是,还有人
在世界上,我可以治愈! 再见!

source:
Well, I've got to set out as well. I
really wanted to stay with the king,
but I can't face the Shine Raid...
translation:
我也得出发了 页:1
很想和国王在一起
但我无法面对神电...

source:
There are still potions I haven't
tested... I mean, there are still people
in the world I can heal! See ya!
translation:
还有一些药水，我尚未
测试... 我的意思是,还有人
在世界上,我可以治愈! 再见!

source:
Leaving?
Come, let me get a last look at you.
translation:
离开?
来吧,让我得到最后一次看你。

source:
All right, please give them hell!
Don't get swallowed by light.
When in trouble, it's OK to retreat.
translation:
好吧,请给他们地狱!
别被光吞下去
遇到麻烦时,可以撤退

source:
The world must be saved,
so long as you live, you can labor to
restore order... Do not die.
translation:
世界必须被拯救
只要你活着,你就可以努力
恢复秩序... 别死

source:
All right, go give it to 'em! Don't
let that light swallow you. When
in trouble, go for a quick retreat.
translation:
好吧,去给他们! 不要这样
让光吞噬你 何时
有麻烦了,赶快撤退

source:
The world must be saved,
so long as you live, you can labor
to restore order... Do not die.
translation:
世界必须被拯救
只要你活着,你就能劳作
来恢复秩序... 别死

source:
<PLAYER>, I see you're going
to face the fallen angel. You may
look a beast, but you're a hero.
translation:
<PLAYER>, I see you're going
面对堕落的天使 你可以的
看起来像个野兽 但你是个英雄

source:
Well, your highness, I have one last
job. I will instruct you in one of my
techniques. It is simple, but effective.
translation:
殿下,我还有最后一个
任务。 我将指导你在我的一个
技术。 它简单但有效。

source:
Queen, you're setting out to slay the
fallen angel. You will not fail. I have 
not even the slightest doubt of that.
translation:
皇后,你准备去杀
堕落的天使 你不会失败的 我见过 
连一点怀疑都没有

source:
Well, your majesty, I have one last
job. I will instruct you in one of my
techniques. It is simple, but effective.
translation:
陛下,我还有最后一个
任务。 我将指导你在我的一个
技术。 它简单但有效。

source:
<PLAYER>, I see you're going to
slay the fallen angel. You've grown.
Only yesterday you were a child!
translation:
<PLAYER>, I see you're going to
杀了那个堕落的天使 你长大了
昨天你还是个孩子!

source:
Well, your highness, I have one last
job. I will instruct you in one of my
techniques. It is simple, but effective.
translation:
殿下,我还有最后一个
任务。 我将指导你在我的一个
技术。 它简单但有效。
电源攻击(_稍强攻击)_\c[52]可疑交易报告_-2

source:
Shall we chat then?
What do you want to talk about?
translation:
我们能聊聊吗?
你想谈什么?

source:
The \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] does more
than swallow the land and sea.
It effects the world itself.
translation:
缩略语 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0] 更厉害
而不是吞下陆地和海洋。
它影响到世界本身。

source:
It makes monsters more ferocious.
They've broken out of dungeons
to attack towns and travelers.
translation:
它使怪物更凶猛。
他们从地牢里逃出来
攻击城镇和旅行者

source:
Since the calamity, people can
no longer tell friend from foe.
translation:
灾难发生后,人们可以
不再告诉敌人的朋友。

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], surely you've
seen \c[52]monsters that glow red\c[0]?
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]当然,你
看见 \c[52]红色的怪物\c[0]?

source:
Glowing Red Monsters
are far more powerful.
translation:
光辉红色怪兽
更强大。

source:
Without proper armor you will
certainly lose \c[53]1/3\c[0] of your HP.
translation:
没有合适的盔甲,你会的
输定了 \c[53]1/3\c[0] 的HP。 。 。

source:
If you encounter them, I recommend
running. If you want to fight them,
you need equipment, items and skills.
translation:
如果你遇到他们,我建议
运行。 如果你想打他们,
您需要设备、物品和技能。

source:
Also, in Normal difficulty and above,
you'll find packs of monsters 
led by a boss.
translation:
而且,在正常困难和以上,
你会发现一包怪物 
由老板领导。

source:
Many have a number of special
powers like casting curses,
flying, or fire breathing.
translation:
很多人都有特别的
力量如诅咒,
飞行,或火焰呼吸。

source:
If a pack of animals attack, kill the 
leader. Spare the others or face the 
wrath of the Forest Guardians.
translation:
如果一包动物攻击,杀死 
头儿 饶了别人或面对别人 
森林守护者的愤怒

source:
I think you know, but \c[52]Lapis\c[0] is the
currency of this world. You need it
for all sorts of business.
translation:
我想你应该知道,但是... \c[52]拉比斯\c[0] 是
这个世界的货币。 你需要它吗?
从事各种业务

source:
When there is something you want
in a town and you don't have enough
money, you can sell something.
translation:
当有你想要的东西
在一个小镇,你没有足够的
钱,你可以卖的东西。

source:
When you have the chance to sell,
sell what you don't need. Lapis is
easier to carry than items.
translation:
当你有机会卖的时候
卖你不需要的东西 拉毕斯
比物品更容易携带。

source:
But even merchants only carry so
much money. If you sell more than
they can afford you take the loss.
translation:
但即使商人也只能这样
很多钱。 如果你卖得比
他们付得起你的损失

source:
You think you'd want as much Lapis
as you can get your hands on,
but actually...
translation:
你以为你会想要一样多拉皮斯
当你可以得到你的手,
但实际上...

source:
The more Lapis you have,
the more bandits will set upon you.
How they find out, I'm not sure...
translation:
你越多拉皮斯,
越多土匪会攻击你
他们怎么知道的 我不确定...

source:
Also, after clearing the game,
you can't take Lapis with you.
translation:
而且,在清理游戏后,
你不能带走拉皮斯

source:
So it's important to buy what you
need instead of trying to hoard
money.
translation:
所以买你的东西很重要
需要而不是试图囤积
钱

source:
If you have \c[52]Charisma\c[0], allies and ally
NPCs will help you on your journey.
But that's not all Charisma does.
translation:
如果你有的话 \c[52]魅力主义a\c[0]盟友和盟友
NPCs会帮助你的旅程。
但Charisma并没有做到这么多

source:
The higher your Charisma is, the
better your allies will fight in battle,
and your shopping will cost less.
translation:
你的Charisma越高越好
你们的盟友最好在战斗中战斗
你的购物成本会更低

source:
Spending Charisma has great
rewards. But then again, so does
saving it. What to do, what to do...
translation:
花花果实是伟大的
奖励。 但是,再说一遍, 也是一样
保存它。 怎么办,怎么办...

source:
Also, crime will lower your Charisma.
Classes reliant on Charisma would
do better not to commit crimes.
translation:
还有,犯罪会降低你的魅力
依赖Charisma的班级
最好不要犯罪。

source:
At the Game Clear or Game Over
screen you get \c[52]Genesis Stones\c[0]
based on your evaluation.
translation:
在游戏清除或游戏结束
屏幕 \c[52]创世石\c[0]
根据你的评估。

source:
The amount of Genesis Stones gained
relies on \c[53]5\c[0] things: \c[52]Level\c[0], \c[52]Distance\c[0],
\c[52]Combat\c[0], \c[52]Assets\c[0], and \c[52]Titles\c[0].

Level is judged according
to your \c[52]Finishing Level\c[0].
translation:
等级根据
给您的 \c[52]完成关卡\c[0].

source:
Your Finishing Level is determined by
\c[52]Number of Levels Gained\c[0], so even if
you spend levels that will not affect it.
translation:
您的结束级别由
\c[52]获得的级别数\c[0],所以即使
你花费的水平不会影响它。

source:
Distance is determined according
to your \c[52]Distance Traveled\c[0].
translation:
距离根据
给您的 \c[52]旅行次数\c[0].

source:
Combat is mainly determined 
according to \c[52]Number of 
Enemies Defeated\c[0].
translation:
战斗主要是决定的 
根据 \c[52]数目 
击败敌人\c[0].

source:
- Strength of Defeated Enemies
- How much Damage was Taken
- Who Struck First in Battle
etc. will affect your assessment.
translation:
- 击败敌人的力量
- 损失了多少
- 谁在战斗中先斯特洛克
等会 这会影响你的评估

source:
Assets depends on the \c[52]Net Worth\c[0]
of your inventory, meaning
Lapis held plus item value.
translation:
资产取决于 \c[52]净值\c[0]
的库存,意思是
拉皮斯持有和物品价值。

source:
Finally, \c[52]Titles Gained\c[0] is determined
according to total titles acquired.
translation:
终于 \c[52]获得的标题\c[0] 确定
根据获得的总产权。

source: \c[52]Slay the Fallen Angel\c[0] for a bonus title.
translation: \c[52]击败堕落天使\c[0] 奖赏头衔

source:
Self-imposed limits also yield 
bonus titles. \c[52]Use Less Perks\c[0]
or \c[52]Avoid Using Storage\c[0].
translation:
自我施加的限制也产生效果 
奖金 \c[52]使用较少的 Perks\c[0]
ưμ㼯A \c[52]避免使用存储\c[0].
盟国、盟国国家联络中心和经验

source:
Hello...
Any last thing you want to ask?
translation:
哈啰...
你想问的最后一件事吗?

source:
First, just basics... Higher \c[52]Accuracy\c[0]
makes it easier to hit, and higher
\c[52]Evasion\c[0] makes it easier to dodge.
translation:
首先,只是基础... 高点 \c[52]准确性\c[0]
更容易被击中 更高一点
\c[52]撤离\c[0] 这样就更容易躲了

source:
Evasion increases with Agility, but
Accuracy does not.
translation:
逃逸随着敏捷而增加,但
准确性并不明显。

source:
To increase your Accuracy you'll
need to use high Accuracy skills,
equipment and accessories.
translation:
为了提高你的准确度,你会
需要使用高精度技能,
设备和配件。

source:
By the way, no matter how high
your Evasion, you'll take a hit 1
out of every 20 times. Don't forget.
translation:
顺便说一句,不管有多高
你的逃兵,你会中枪的 1
每一个 20 时间。 别忘了

source:
Some classes get experience just
for entering dungeons and towns.
translation:
有的班级才有经验
进入地牢和城镇

source:
So even if you have no other reason
to stop in, you can get XP without
combat if you're an applicable class.
translation:
所以即使你没有别的理由
要停下来,你可以得到 XP 没有
战斗,如果你是一个适用的类。

source:
It's a perk common to many of the
weaker classes with low combat
ability...
translation:
这是一种常见的礼让
低战力的弱小阶级
能力...

source:
It can be tough for these classes
to get XP fighting, so get it by visiting
those places as much as you can.
translation:
这些课会很辛苦的
为了让XP战斗, 所以通过访问得到它
尽你所能去那些地方

source:
Actually, the more party members
you have, the less XP you can get.
translation:
其实,党员越多
你有,你得到的XP越少。

source:
Each party member means a 20% cut
in XP. Might be good to think about.
translation:
每个党员是指 20剪切%
在 XP 中 。 考虑一下也许不错

source:
If it's personal development you want,
it might be better to travel alone.
translation:
如果这是你想要的个人发展
单独旅行可能更好

source:
And if an ally NPC defeats a monster,
you'll get 25% experience.
translation:
如果NPC的盟友打败了怪物
你会得到 25经验

source:
With an \c[52]Avenger Bangle\c[0] equipped, the
XP gained when an ally NPC slays
a monster is quadrupled to 100%.
translation:
与一个 \c[52]复仇笼罩\c[0] 设备,
当一个盟国NPC杀死了XP
一个怪物四倍到 100%.

source:
It's pretty good news if you find that
item while you have an ally NPC, eh?
translation:
如果你发现这个消息,那真是好消息
你有一个盟友NPC,是吗?

source:
Ally NPCs, unlike allies, do not share
the same tile as you which makes 
them tricky to manage.
translation:
爱丽NPCs,不像盟友,不分享
和你做的一样的瓷砖 
他们很难处理。

source:
However, they level up each time
they defeat an enemy. Train them
to be good companions.
translation:
不过,他们每次都会平整
他们打败了敌人 训练他们
做个好伙伴

source:
Regardless of training, ally NPCs
cannot climb mountains and
\c[52]Teleport Potions\c[0] will separate you.
translation:
不论培训情况如何,全国人大联盟
无法攀登山峰
\c[52]电传口水\c[0] 会把你分开的

source:
It can be tough to stay together
for your entire journey.
translation:
在一起会很难的
整个旅程。

source:
By the way, there are also ally NPCs
devoted to carrying items for you.
translation:
顺便说一句,还有盟国国家指挥中心
专为您携带物品。

source:
Journey far and perhaps you'll
find one to bring to the castle.
translation:
远走高飞,也许你会
找到一个带到城堡。

source:
Their max load is based on amount,
not weight, so make them do
the heavy lifting.
translation:
他们的最大负荷 根据数量,
而不是重量,所以要他们做
沉重的举起。

source:
But if you get separated from them
while they are carrying an item, you
may never get it back.
translation:
但如果你和他们分开
当他们携带一件物品的时候,
可能永远拿不回来

source:
So you should be more careful than
usual when using an ally NPC
to carry your stuff.
translation:
所以,你应该更加小心
使用 Ally NPC 时通常使用
带着你的东西。

source:
\c[52]Raw meat\c[0] is an item you often get
from slaying beasts, but if you eat it
as is, you may get \c[52]Food Poisoning\c[0].
translation:
\c[52]原始肉类\c[0] 是一个你经常得到的东西
杀野兽,但如果你吃了它
现在,你可能会得到 \c[52]食品中毒\c[0].

source:
If you have the \c[52]Force BBQ\c[0],
you can use that to grill something
tasty. But you won't always have that.
translation:
如果你有的话 \c[52]强制 BBQ\c[0],
你可以用它来烤东西
味道不错。 但你不会永远拥有它。

source:
Another way to get \c[52]Grilled Meat\c[0]
is when you are the one grilled by a
flame attack...
translation:
另一条路 \c[52]灰熊肉类\c[0]
当你是被一个烤
火焰攻击...

source:
You could also proactively look for
ways to cook to them.
translation:
你也可以主动寻找
给他们做饭的方法

source:
There are other ways to cook meat.
Try to drop \c[52]Raw Meat\c[0]
then throw a \c[52]Flame Bottle\c[0] at it.
translation:
做肉还有别的办法
试着放下 \c[52]原生肉类\c[0]
然后扔一个 \c[52]火焰瓶\c[0] 来点吧

source:
Make sure to be out of the
blast radius yourself.
translation:
一定要离开
爆炸半径你自己。

source:
If you can use a Force, try \c[52]Flame
Force\c[0]. As \c[52]EN\c[0] is important to
Sorcerers, learning it can be useful.
translation:
如果你能用力的话,试试看 \c[52]火焰
理力\c[0]. 原为 \c[52]饱食度\c[0] 很重要的一点
巫师,学习它可能有用。

source:
I cannot create a path to him...
Not from here...
translation:
我不能创造一条通往他的道路...
不是从这里...

source:
Quests from this person
can only be undertaken
on \c[52]Hard\c[0] difficulty or above.
translation:
这个人的询问
只能进行
开 开 \c[52]困难\c[0] 难度或以上。

source:
Child of Konrath...
It seems you now have another
purpose.
translation:
康拉特之子...
看来你现在又有了
目标。

source:
Such is the nature of the world...
This experience shall serve as a
memory when you start anew.
translation:
这就是世界的本质...
这种经验应作为:
重新开始记忆。

source:
You're already on another quest.
You cannot join multiple quests
simultaneously.
translation:
你已经在进行另一个任务了
你不能加入多重任务
同时。

source:
You've inherited many
\c[52]memories\c[0] from your journeys
and grown to be quite a gallant figure.
translation:
你继承了很多
\c[52]记忆\c[0] 从您的旅途中
变成一个相当勇敢的人物

source:
Uh? \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], it's not like
this is your first time leaving the
castle, but... What's he talking about?
translation:
额? Uh? \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],这不是像
这是你第一次离开
城堡,不过... 他在说什么?

source:
Well, will you listen to my one
request?
translation:
好吧,你会听我的
请求?

source:
No no, we can't!
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] has to slay the
Fallen Angel, that's our first priority...
translation:
不,不,我们不能!
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 必须杀死
堕落天使,这是我们的首要任务

source:
Is that right?
How about I tell you the truth behind
this world destroying calamity?
translation:
是吗?
不如我告诉你真相吧
这个世界毁灭了灾难?

source:
What...
The Fallen Angel's not behind it...
translation:
什麽...
堕落天使不是幕后黑手

source:
How about I tell you who is really
behind the calamity consuming
this world?
translation:
不如我告诉你谁是真正的
灾祸的背后,
这个世界?

source:
I'll leave it to you to decide whether
you believe me or not.
translation:
由你决定
你信不信由你,你不信吗?

source:
Collect 5 \c[52]Dream Stones\c[0].
I'll be waiting for you.
translation:
收集 5 \c[52]梦之石\c[0].
我会等你的

source:
Is that so...
I shall see you in another world then.
translation:
是这样吗?

translation:
那么,这是什么? 你想问我什么?
我什么都告诉你!

source:

translation:
现在,你有问题要问

如果我被墙堵住了怎么办?

source: Yeah, what do you want to know?

translation:

source:
\c[52]Prairie\c[0] features, right!
Um, I think it's a relatively safe area.
translation:
\c[52]帕蕊\c[0] 性格,没错!
嗯,我认为这是一个相对安全的地区。

source:
There isn't much dangerous terrain,
Towns appear normally, and you can
gets lots of food to restore EN!
translation:
这里没有太多危险的地形,
城镇的出现很正常,你可以
买很多食物来恢复EN!

source:
You should gather items and things when you can,
but don't let your guard down!
translation:
你应该收集的东西,当你可以,
但别放松警惕!

source:
\c[52]Wilds\c[0] features, right!
It's not very dangerous... but almost all the
herbs have dried up, and there aren't many towns.
translation:
\c[52]野生动物\c[0] 性格,没错!
这不很危险... 但几乎所有
草药已经干涸了,没有太多的城镇。

source:
It looks like there's not much dangerous terrain.
But you might have to be careful of running out of EN.
translation:
看起来没有太多危险的地形
但你可能得小心 跑出EN。

source:
Sometimes monsters like animals,
demons, or thieves appear.
translation:
有时像动物一样的怪物
恶魔,或者小偷出现。

source:
\c[52]Ruins\c[0] features, right!
There are a lot of dungeons, I guess.
This is a great area for adventure lovers.
translation:
\c[52]废墟\c[0] 性格,没错!
有很多地牢,我想。
这是一个伟大的领域 冒险情人。

source:
There are also lots of weapon, armor,
and scroll drops.
translation:
还有很多武器,盔甲,
和滚动滴滴。

source:
I think this is a great area to improve
your fighting ability.
But make sure you bring plenty of food.
translation:
我认为这是一个伟大的领域 改进
你的战斗能力。
但要保证你带很多食物

source:
The monsters are mostly demons and undead.
Watch out for enemies with ranged attacks.
translation:
怪物大多是恶魔和死神
当心敌人的射程攻击

source:
\c[52]Snow Field\c[0] features, right!
The biggest feature is... the cold!!!
EN decreases like crazy...
translation:
\c[52]雪地场\c[0] 性格,没错!
最大的特征是... 冰凉!
爱因斯坦像疯子一样减少...

source:
When we enter the Snow Field, I'll be hiding inside
your bag if you need me, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
translation:
当我们进入雪田时,我会躲在里面
如果你需要我的话 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
Even if you restore EN, it will drain right away,
so it might be a good idea to just push on to
a warm place without restoring EN.
translation:
即使你恢复了EN, 它会很快地耗尽,
因此,这可能是一个好主意,只是推到
一个温暖的地方,没有恢复EN。

source:
There's almost no food to find that will fill you up,
but there's lots of strong monsters and you'll have
to fight , and it's difficult to fight with zero EN.
translation:
几乎没有食物可以让你饱饱肚子
但有很多强大的怪物,你会有
战斗, 和它很难与零EN战斗。

source:
When you have to fight strong monsters, it might
be a good idea to fight after you restore a little
EN by eating herbs.
translation:
当你要和强大的怪物战斗时,它可能会
改过自新后再战斗
通过吃草药。

source:
\c[52]Mountains\c[0] features, right!
This is a place where you can find lots of items
to restore EN.
translation:
\c[52]山区\c[0] 性格,没错!
这里是您可以找到很多项目的地方
来恢复EN。

source: We should replenish our food here.
translation: 我们应该在这里补充食物

source: The monsters are mostly birds and animal types.
translation: 怪物大多是鸟类和动物

source:
\c[52]Volcano\c[0] features, right!
There are almost no towns.
translation:
\c[52]火山喷发\c[0] 性格,没错!
几乎没有任何城镇。

source:
Of course not, it's way too hot
to live there.
translation:
当然不是,太热了
住在这里。

source: There's lava inside, so be careful!

If you go in the lava, it's basically Game Over!
You'll die.
translation:
如果你进入熔岩, 它基本上是游戏结束!
你会死的

source:
Of course, almost all the herbs you can find there
are burnt. There are many gems, so you can
take them for your travel funds.
translation:
当然,几乎所有的草药你都能找到
被烧焦了 有很多宝石,所以你可以
带他们去买旅行费

source:
\c[52]Desert\c[0] features, right!
It's an area totally covered in sand.
translation:
\c[52]沙漠区\c[0] 性格,没错!
这是一个完全覆盖在沙子上的区域。

source:
Movement gets slower in the desert.
Your ST constantly drains,
so keep your EN up to restore ST.
translation:
沙漠的移动速度越来越慢
你不断的排水,
让你的EN起来 恢复ST。

source:
Be careful when fighting flying monsters.
They're not affected by the terrain when flying
so they might gang up on you.
translation:
和飞兽战斗时要小心
飞行时不会受到地形的影响
那样他们就会聚在一起对付你

source:
And if they find you, they're faster so
they'll catch you pretty easily.
translation:
如果他们发现你,他们的速度更快
他们会很容易抓到你的

source:
Of course the Fallen Angel can also fly so you
should do your best to avoid her in the Desert.
translation:
当然,堕落天使也能飞,所以你
应该尽力避免她出现在沙漠里

source:
\c[52]Corrupted Lands\c[0] features, right!
This is... a very dangerous place.
translation:
\c[52]被破坏的土地\c[0] 性格,没错!
这是... 一个非常危险的地方

source:
What's dangerous is that the monsters that
appear are much stronger than others.
translation:
最危险的是那些怪物
看上去比别人强得多

source:
And it seems there are almost no towns...
Don't needlessly fight every fight, you should
run away when it's appropriate.
translation:
似乎没有城镇...
不要无谓地打架,你应该
适当的时候就跑吧

source:
What is this super giant building?
Who built it?
translation:
这个超级巨型建筑是什么?
谁造的?

source:
Um, it looks like you can get a lot of weapons.
The walls are harder than in towns, and the
monsters are strong so make sure to use good weapons!
translation:
嗯,它看起来像你可以得到 很多武器。
城墙比镇上更坚固
怪物很强壮,一定要用好武器!

source:
It also looks like there are lots of treasure chests,
if you can make it through you can really fill up.
translation:
看起来还有好多宝箱
如果你能挺过去,你真的可以填满。

source:
It's an ocean and sand area.
Look out for flying enemies just like in the desert.
translation:
这是一个海洋和沙地区域。
注意飞行的敌人 就像沙漠里一样

source:
Keep moving while checking the mini map here.
It's fine if you're really good at swimming, but
land is sparse and if you're not careful you'll sink.
translation:
继续前进,同时检查这里的小地图。
如果你真的擅长游泳,也没关系,但是...
土地很稀少 如果你不小心的话 你会沉下去的

source: The monsters are mostly flying types and fish.
translation: 怪兽大多是飞行型的和鱼

source:
Right, if you eat \c[52]Seaweed\c[0], your ST
will regenerate for a while. You should eat
some before you have no choice but to swim.
translation:
对,如果你吃 \c[52]海藻\c[0],您的 ST
会再生一段时间。 你该吃饭了
在你没有选择之前 有一些只能游泳。

source:
\c[52]Large Cave\c[0] features, right!
This is an area surrounded by dirt walls.
translation:
\c[52]大洞穴\c[0] 性格,没错!
这是一个被泥墙包围的地区。

source:
If you're lucky you'll find a path,
but otherwise you'll have to dig your own.
translation:
如果你幸运的话,你会找到一条路
否则你就得自己挖了

source:
Also, the paths are narrow so if you face
monsters, it will be difficult to run away.
translation:
还有,道路很窄,所以如果你面对
怪兽们,要逃跑是很难的

source:
\c[52]Pickaxe\c[0]'s can dig through walls
easily. But they have \c[1]low accuracy\c[0] so
change to a weapon when fighting.
translation:
\c[52]镐\c[0]能够挖墙
简单。 但他们有 \c[1]精度低\c[0] 原来如此
战斗时换成武器

source: ...Why are we in the sky? It's so high! It's so scary!
translation: ...为什么我们在天上? 这么高! 太吓人了!

source:
Why am I scared even though I can fly?
I've never flown this high before!
It's scary!
translation:
为什么我害怕,即使我能飞?
我从来没有飞过这么高!
太吓人了!

source: Obviously the monsters are mostly flying types.
translation: 很明显 怪物大多是飞行型的

source:
Of course if you fall into one of the holes
a Game Over is inevitable! You have to be careful
to use the map here more than anywhere.
translation:
当然 如果你掉进一个洞里
游戏结束是不可避免的! 你要小心点
使用地图比任何地方都多。

source:
\c[52]Large Forest\c[0] features, right!
There are almost no towns or dungeons, it seems
to be an area surrounded by forests and mountains.
translation:
\c[52]大型森林\c[0] 性格,没错!
似乎没有城镇或地牢
成为森林和山岳环绕的地区

source:
There are plenty of items to restore EN.
Be sure to fill up on food.
translation:
有很多东西可以修复EN
一定要填满食物。

source:
The monsters are also mostly animals and birds.
Sometimes you can't see the monsters when
moving through the forest, so look out.
translation:
怪物也大多是动物和鸟类
有时你看不到怪物
穿过森林,所以当心。

source:
This place is amazing... It's like a dream.
Just where are we walking now, anyway?
translation:
这地方太神奇了 这就像一个梦。
我们现在要去哪儿?

source:
There are many things like dungeons and towns.
The enemies are also really strong.
translation:
有很多东西,比如地牢和城镇。
敌人也非常强大

source:
Until we meet Hades...
Let's be careful and keep moving!
translation:
直到我们见到哈迪斯...
我们小心点,继续前进!

source: To save all the worlds connected to here...
translation: 为了拯救所有连接到这里的世界...

我们...
我们必须打败哈迪斯! \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!

source: Not equipping weapons or armor is just stupid!
translation: 不装备武器或盔甲是愚蠢的!

source: Not equipping weapons or armor is just stupid!
translation: 不装备武器或盔甲是愚蠢的!

source: N-Not equipping weapons or armor is just stupid!
translation: 不装备武器或盔甲是愚蠢的!

source: Huh? Is there anything I want to ask \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]?
translation: 是吗? 有什么我想问的吗? \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]?

source:
Being asked that after I've been your caretaker
for so long... Hmmmmmmm...
translation:
我当你的看门人后被问起
这么久... Hmmmmmmm...

嗯... 来吧 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
你在开玩笑吧... 对吧?

source:
Hey! That's mean, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
You're unexpectedly sadistic.
Hey, is it fun picking on me? Huh, is it fun?
translation:
喂！ 这很刻薄 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
你是出乎意料的虐待狂。
嘿 挑逗我好玩吗? 好玩吗?

source:
Hmm, OK then...
Stop kidding around, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! Ahahaha!!
translation:
嗯,那么,没关系... ... Hmm, OK then...
别开玩笑了 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! 啊哈哈! 阿哈哈! 阿哈哈!

source:
But I never expected that when I met you,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], that I'd be traveling the world
with a hero.
translation:
但我没料到当我遇见你时
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]我会环游世界
和一个英雄在一起

source:
I was lost walking in the forest on a moonlit night,
and I came near the castle. I saw you by a window
and called out.
translation:
在月光之夜我迷失在森林里
我来到城堡附近 我看见你在窗边
喊叫着说,

source:
We talked and found we had a lot in common.
I even got interested in different people from the
castle and talked about you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
translation:
我们谈过了,发现我们有很多共同点
我甚至对不同的人感兴趣
城堡和谈论你, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
I talked to you about it, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], and you
asked the king for me.
That's how I became your caretaker.
translation:
我和你谈过了 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], and you
找国王找我
所以我才成为你的守护者

source:
There are books gathered from all over the country
in the castle and there are people from all over,
I was really able to learn a lot.
translation:
从全国各地收集的书
在城堡里,有来自各地的人,
我真的能学到很多东西。

source:
Then the world got like this, and when I was told that
you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], had to go on a journey as a hero,
I had to go with you.
translation:
然后世界就变成这样了 当我被告知
you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]以英雄身份踏上征途
我必须和你一起去。

source: Wow, it's not like me to talk so much!
translation: 哇,它不喜欢我 说话这么多!
是吗? 你不这么认为吗?

source:
Anyway, the food in the castle was really delicious.
All the cooks worked really hard for us.
translation:
总之,城堡里的食物真的很美味
所有的厨师都为我们工作得很辛苦

source:
The chef was the most amazing of all.
He knows sooo many recipes.
translation:
厨师是最惊人的。
他知道很多秘方。

source:
No matter what you ate, it was all superb!
Aww, I miss that flavor...
translation:
无论你吃什么,都很棒!
哦,我怀念那种味道... ...

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], your father King Konrath really is
an amazing person.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]你父亲康拉特真的
一个了不起的人

source:
He was a little scary,
but he was popular with the people.
He had dignity, and he ruled the nation well.
translation:
他有点吓人
但是他很受民众欢迎
他有尊严,他统治着国家

source:
In times of war,
he just kept winning like he had divine protection.
translation:
在战争时期
他一直赢 就像他有神的保护。

source:
He was the perfect king.
He did spoil you a little though, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
translation:
他是完美的国王
他确实把你宠坏了 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
Which reminds me, he studied the cultivation
and breeding of Mandragora at the castle.
translation:
这提醒了我,他学习了种植
和曼德拉戈拉的繁殖 在城堡。

source:
When I first heard that
I thought
"Ewww... That's scary."
translation:
当我第一次听到
我以为
"Ewww... ... "Ewww... ..." "Ewww... 这是可怕的。"

source:
They'll grow even in really bad environments,
and they have lots of nutrients.
translation:
即使在非常糟糕的环境中,它们也会成长
他们有很多营养。

source:
And apparently, "nothing happens if you hear
their scream." They're doing incredible research.
translation:
显然,"没有什么发生,如果你听到
他们正在做令人难以置信的研究

source:
But...couldn't they breed them not to scream?
At least I thought so.
It's scary and weird when they scream.
translation:
但是... 他们难道不能繁殖他们不尖叫吗?
至少我是这么想的
当他们尖叫的时候,这很可怕和奇怪。

source:
The soldiers of the castle are fiercely loyal
and are good people...
translation:
城堡的士兵们忠心耿耿
他们是好人...

source: Some of them have pretty big heads, though.

The captain, he has incredible ability with
the sword and many skills, but...
translation:
船长,他有不可思议的能力
剑和许多技能,但是...

source:
He's even better at teaching people.
He had a really good reputation from the new
soldiers' training and things, didn't he?
translation:
他更擅长教人
他从新来的名声很好
士兵训练什么的,不是吗?

source:
There were really a lot of educated people at the castle.
Just by talking to the people working there,
I was able to learn all kinds of things.
translation:
城堡里真的有很多受过教育的人
和那里的员工谈话
我学会了各种东西

source:
However!! That healer.
That was the one person...I really didn't like.
translation:
不过! 那个治疗师
那是唯一一个... 我真的不喜欢的人

source:
The first time I met him and "Let me study you!"
is the first thing he says? I'm sure fairies are rare,
but he came at me with a really weird attitude.
translation:
我第一次见到他时,就说"让我研究你吧!"
他是第一句话吗? 我敢肯定,仙女是罕见的,
但他对我的态度很奇怪

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], if you hadn't protected me,
I might have ended up dissolved in some liquid
and put in some glass container...
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]如果你不保护我
我可能最终溶解在液体中
然后放进玻璃容器里...

source:
It seems the newfound ability to breed Mandragora
was due in large part to that person.
translation:
这似乎是新发现的繁殖曼德拉戈拉的能力
大部分是该人造成的。

source:
He must be pretty smart.
I don't know what he's thinking, though...
translation:
他一定很聪明
我不知道他在想什么,虽然...

source:
\c[50]Keyton\c[0] will attack with a sword for you.
He's a childhood friend of yours, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
so I expect awesome teamwork!
translation:
\c[50]键\c[0] 将用剑攻击你。
他是你小时候的朋友 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
所以我希望团队合作很棒!

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], it seems that when you level up,
his affection goes up.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]似乎当你平整下来时
他的爱会增加

source:
\c[50]Nami\c[0] is a Force User. She'll attack with Forces for
you. She's a childhood friend of yours, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
so you should be able to coordinate well!
translation:
\c[50]纳米\c[0] 是一个强制用户 。 她会用军队来攻击
you. 她是你小时候的朋友 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0],
这样你就能好好协调了!

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], it seems that when you level up,
her affection goes up.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]似乎当你平整下来时
她的爱会增加

source:
\c[50]Cole\c[0] is just a slob...
But not really.
translation:
\c[50]科尔\c[0] 只是个垃圾...
但其实不是

source:
He has a sword and knowledge,
He'll protect you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], from enemy attacks.
His affection goes up the more you progress.
translation:
他有剑和知识,
他会保护你 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]敌军攻击
他对你的爱越深

source:
\c[50]Draco\c[0] will sometimes attack with fire breath.
He's still young, but what a dragon!
That's how strong his flame is.
translation:
\c[50]德拉科语Name\c[0] 有时会用火焰来攻击。
他还年轻,但多么的龙!
他的火焰就是这样强烈的

source:
On the other hand, his HP is low
so try to make sure he doesn't
take too much damage.
translation:
另一方面,他的HP很低
所以尽量确保他不会
损失太大了

source:
His affection goes up the more you progress.
And it looks like he has a favorite food...
translation:
他对你的爱越深
看起来他有喜欢的食物...

source:
\c[50]Merril\c[0] is an amazingly fast sword dancer.
What a reassuring ally. She's very calm when fighting.
You can really count on her.
translation:
\c[50]梅里尔\c[0] 是一个惊人的快剑舞者。
多么令人放心的盟友啊 她战斗时很冷静
你真的可以信赖她。

source:
If only that shameless personality would change.
Her affection goes up when you beat strong enemies.
translation:
如果这种无耻的人格能改变就好了
当你打败敌人时 她的感情就会增加

source:
It's the always smiling, rude, big eating bard, \c[50]Baldur\c[0].
He won't join the battle directly,
but he'll restore your ST with his songs.
translation:
它总是微笑,粗鲁, 大吃巴巴, \c[50]巴尔杜尔\c[0].
他不会直接参战的
但他会用他的歌来恢复你的ST

source:
His affection goes up the more you progress.
And it looks like it'll go up if he eats in town.
translation:
他对你的爱越深
看起来他进城吃饭会涨的

source:
The spearman, \c[50]Aerdou\c[0].
His single, deadly attack has a recoil that's so
strong, even he takes damage from it.
translation:
长矛侠 \c[50]奥尔杜\c[0].
他的单次致命攻击有后坐力
强大,甚至他也承受了伤害。

source:
His affection...
It goes up the more you take damage, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
Ooooh, that's twisted.
translation:
他的爱...
越是造成伤害 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
哦,这是扭曲的。

source:
It's \c[50]Coco and Muddy\c[0].
Muddy is strong and hard
so he's really reliable.
translation:
这是 \c[50]可可和泥土\c[0].
泥土坚硬有力
所以他很可靠

source:
They'll reduce the effect of sand in the desert.
Their affection goes up when you defeat enemies.
translation:
他们会减少沙漠中沙子的影响
当你打败敌人时,他们的感情就会增加

source:
\c[50]Dosey\c[0] will heal you! But, if you get wounded
frequently, she can't make enough medicine. Also
she'll only heal you when you're fighting so be careful!
translation:
\c[50]多西岛\c[0] 会治好你的! 但是,如果你受伤了
经常,她不能做足够的药。 还有
她只会治愈你 当你战斗的时候,所以要小心!

source:
She was born in the snow country, so she'll halve the
effects of snow! Her affection goes up when you
defeat enemies. And it seems she has a favorite food.
translation:
她出生在雪地国家,所以她会把
雪的影响! 当你的爱意升起的时候
打败敌人 看来她有喜欢的食物

source:
\c[50]Olga\c[0] can't fight,
but she'll tell you the locations of towns.
translation:
\c[50]奥尔加\c[0] 无法战斗,
但她会告诉你城镇的位置

source:
But recently her forgetfulness is getting worse,
and sometimes she can't remember things.
translation:
但最近她的忘却越来越严重了
有时她记不起一些事

source:
Her affection goes up the more you progress.
Maybe it's because we're near the End of the East?
translation:
她的感情越多,你就越有进步
也许是因为我们接近东端了?

source:
If she becomes an ally she'll be a really powerful one!
She'd probably be the strongest ally ever!!
(A little scary, though.)
translation:
如果她成为同盟 她就会成为真正的同盟!
她可能是有史以来最强的盟友!
(虽然有点吓人。 )

source: Her affection goes up when you defeat strong enemies.
translation: 当你击败敌人时 她的感情就会增加

source:
\c[50]Konrath Soldier D\c[0] is a normal castle soldier.
He seems a little big-headed.
He has no affection rating.
translation:
\c[50]Konrath 士兵 D\c[0] 是个普通的城堡士兵
他看起来有点大头了
他没有感情评级。

source:
The \c[50]Female Sword Master\c[0] is beautiful
and cool.
She has no affection rating!
translation:
缩略语 \c[50]女剑师\c[0] 美丽
和凉爽。
她没有感情评级!

source:
The \c[50]Brave Knight\c[0] is an excellent knight.
He's amazing for how young he is.
He has no affection rating.
translation:
缩略语 \c[50]勇敢的骑士\c[0] 是个优秀的骑士
他这么年轻真了不起
他没有感情评级。

source:
The \c[50]Summoned Beast\c[0] is really strong!
But it'll leave after a couple hours so check the
remaining time.
translation:
缩略语 \c[50]传召野兽\c[0] 真的很强壮!
几小时后会走的,你看看
剩余时间。

source:
Your pet is really cute, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
It will stay with you from the beginning,
so you can really see it grow over a long journey!
translation:
你的宠物真可爱 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
它会一直与你在一起 从一开始,
这样你就能看到它长长的长途跋涉!

source:
It's the \c[50]Samurai Princess\c[0]!
If she dies it's Game Over.
You have to protect her no matter what.
translation:
这是... \c[50]武士公主\c[0]!
如果她死了 游戏就结束了
你无论如何都要保护她

source:
Hey! What are you getting excited about?!
You can't, okay? You can't go that way!!
translation:
喂！ 你为什麽这么兴奋?
你不能,好吗? 你不能走那边!

source:
If the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] catches up to you
you'll turn to ash in an instant and it's Game Over!
Now, let's hurry East.
translation:
如果 : \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0] 追上来了
你马上就要变成灰了 游戏结束了!
现在,让我们快点东。

source:
You should attack walls that block your way
to break them.
translation:
你应该攻击挡路的墙壁
打破他们。

source:
You don't like breaking something people
worked so hard on?
translation:
你不喜欢破坏别人的东西
这么辛苦吗?

source:
You can't think of anything like that if you're
swallowed by the \c[52]Shine Raid\c[0] you'll be
smashed to pieces! Survival comes first!
translation:
如果你是的话,你不可能想到这样的事
被吞没了 \c[52]光辉突袭\c[0] 你会的
被打成碎片了! 生存是第一位的

source: I mean, you don't need to break them for no reason...
translation: 我的意思是,你不需要 打破它们无缘无故...

source:
There are weapons that are good and not so good
for breaking walls.
Arrows have no effect on walls so be careful.
translation:
有好武器,有不好的武器
因为打破墙壁。
箭头对墙壁没有作用 所以要小心

source:
EN is the source of your energy!
When it's low, ST won't recover and HP recovery
slows down.
translation:
EN是你的能量来源!
当它低的时候,ST不会恢复 和HP恢复
慢下来。

source: Some skills can't be used without EN.
translation: 有些技能没有EN是不能使用的。

source:
You can restore EN by eating 
lunch boxes, fruit, or meat!
translation:
吃东西可以恢复EN 
午餐盒,水果,还是肉!

source:
EN just depletes on its own so "when you eat" is more
important than when you use it.
translation:
自己吃饱了,吃饱了就更好了
比你用的时候重要

source:
But food will normally spoil when you carry it,
so there's a risk to always holding on to it...
It's rough.
translation:
但食物通常会腐烂 当你携带它,
所以总有坚持下去的风险
这是粗糙。

source: Not equipping weapons or armor isn't a good idea.
translation: 不装备武器或盔甲可不是个好主意

source:
Of course you have to equip weapons and armor, but
the durability depletes when you equip and use them!
translation:
你当然要装备武器和盔甲
当你们装备并使用它们的时候,耐久性会枯竭!

source:
You should make sure you know just how much
durability is left.
translation:
你应该确保你知道多少
耐久性还剩下

source:
If you don't watch the durability,
at an important moment your sword could go
*crack!* and that would be a tragedy.
translation:
如果你不看 耐久,
在一个重要的时刻 你的剑可以去
简直是悲剧

source:
Still, there are many types of equipment.
It must be difficult deciding which to take when
you're over your weight limit.
translation:
但是,仍然有许多类型的设备。
一定很难决定什么时候要
你已经超重了

source:
There are things you may prefer or not, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
Their usefulness changes with the situation.
translation:
有些事情你可能喜欢或不喜欢, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
它们的用处随着形势的变化而改变。

source:
Which weapon to carry, and which to leave. That
decision could change the course of your journey...
translation:
携带什么武器,离开什么武器 那个
你的决定会改变你的旅程...

source:
Hmm, right. This is the most basic of basics,
but when you see enemies it's important to
take each step carefully.
translation:
嗯,没错。 这是最基本的东西
但是当你看到敌人的时候,重要的是
每一步都要小心一点

source:
Sometimes, like in dark buildings or at night, you
can't tell when they're close, so you have to be
extra careful at those times.
translation:
有时,像在黑暗的建筑里,或者在夜晚,你
分不清他们何时接近 所以你必须知道
那时候要多加小心

source:
Well, there's nothing you can do if you're ambushed
or attacked by a large group.
translation:
如果你被伏击了,你什么都做不了
或受到大群人的攻击。

source:
It's good to carry a \c[52]Teleport Potion\c[0]
at times like those...
translation:
带一个很好 \c[52]电传口水\c[0]
在这种时候...

source:
But it's not often you have the right item at the
right time, so it can be tough.
translation:
但不常有合适的项目
时机对了,所以会很艰难

source:
At critical moments like those you should use the
\c[52]Skill\c[0], \c[52]Awakening\c[0]! But you can only use it 5 times in
1 adventure, so you want to use sparingly.
translation:
在这种关键时刻,你应该使用
\c[52]技能\c[0], \c[52]觉醒\c[0]! 但你只能用这个 5 时数
1 冒险,所以你想 少用。

source:
In situations where it would be dangerous to get
caught in a \c[52]Trap\c[0] or in suspicious places,
you can attack that tile to see if there's a trap or not.
translation:
在危险的情况下
被困在一个 \c[52]陷阱\c[0] 或在可疑的地方,
你可以攻击瓷砖 看看有没有陷阱

source:
If you find one, swing your weapon one more time
to disarm the trap!
translation:
如果你找到一个,再挥动你的武器一次
解除陷阱!

source:
There are traps that do direct damage and those
that inflict status effects.
Some of them even summon monsters.
translation:
有一些陷阱 直接损坏和那些
造成身份影响
有些人甚至会召唤怪物

source:
What kind of jerk would set something so dangerous
outside?
translation:
什么样的混蛋会设置 东西如此危险
外面吗?

source:
There's nothing worse than focusing on a fight to the
death with a monster and getting a Game Over from
stepping on a trap.
translation:
没有什么比专心打斗更糟糕的了
和怪物一起死亡 游戏结束
踩着陷阱

source:
Watch out for traps especially when you least expect
them!
translation:
当心陷阱,尤其是你最没料到的时候
他们!

source:
That's a time for the \c[52]Area Map\c[0]! Using it lets
you know the locations of dungeons and towns.
translation:
是时候了 \c[52]面积图\c[0]! 使用它让
你知道地牢和城镇的位置

source:
But you won't know forever, so make sure
you check how long the effect will last from
the menu.
translation:
但你不会永远知道的,所以确保
您检查效果将持续多久
菜单。

source:
Not only the \c[52]Area Map\c[0], it seems there
are lots of items that have a positive effect on you,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
translation:
不仅如此 \c[52]面积图\c[0],它看起来在那里
是很多对你具有积极影响的项目,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].

source:
If you really understand the effects of many items
and don't misjudge when to use them, this journey
will definitely go smoothly...right?
translation:
如果你真的了解很多项目的效果
不要误判何时使用它们,这趟旅程
一定会顺利的 对吧?

source:
A fight for the fate of the world...that's a big
responsibility. You have to come up with a strategy...
translation:
为世界的命运而战... 这可是个大问题
责任。 你必须想出一个策略...

source:
Right, what's most important is to conserve good
tools and equipment.
translation:
对,最重要的是要保护好
工具和设备。

source:
But as you progress, the monsters will get
stronger so it can be difficult.
translation:
但随着你的进化 怪物会得到
更强大,这样就很难了

source:
And leveling up properly!
This might be the most important.
translation:
平整整整齐
这也许是最重要的

source:
Okay.
If you want to know something, ask any time.
translation:
好吧,我们走。
如果你想知道什么 随时问吧

source:
What was that mysterious voice
we heard that time?
translation:
那个神秘的声音是什么?
我们听到那个时候?

source:
It seemed to know about you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
Well, it's no use thinking about it now...
translation:
它似乎了解你, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0].
嗯,这是没有用的 现在考虑它...

source:
Anyway, \c[52]Holy Weapons\c[0] are incredible!
Just looking at them you can tell they're really strong.
translation:
总之 \c[52]圣 灵 器 器\c[0] 太不可思议了!
看着他们就知道他们很强壮

source:
These look like they'll definitely help
us save the world!
You want to save these for fighting strong enemies.
translation:
这些东西看起来一定能派上用场
我们拯救世界!
你想保存这些 与强大的敌人战斗。

source:
Yes...
To think that this type of weapon actually exists.
translation:
对...
想想这种武器真的存在

source:
This weapon... It has genuinely high attack power
and it has a protection that allows it to break
my heavenly barrier.
translation:
这武器... 它有真正的高超攻击力
并且它有一个保护 允许它打破
我的天堂之屏障。

source:
What?! Really?
\c[52]Holy Weapons\c[0] really are amazing...
translation:
什麽? 真的吗?
\c[52]圣 灵 器 器\c[0] 实在是太神奇了...

source:
Yes. But why are these weapons on Earth?
These could never be made
by angels, let alone human hands...
translation:
对 但是,为什么这些武器在地球上?
永远做不来
天使,更别说人类的手

source:
One might even work against
\c[51]Zeukrees\c[0]' barrier...
translation:
甚至有人会反对
\c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0]障碍物...

source:
The journey has just begun!
Let's do our best!
translation:
旅程才刚刚开始!
让我们尽我们所能!

source:
You've progressed pretty far!
Even if I fly as high as I can,
I can't see Konrath's Castle!
translation:
你进步的很远!
即使我飞得越高越好
我看不到康拉斯的城堡!

source:
*Sigh*... The monsters keep getting stronger. But
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you're certainly getting stronger
as well! Keep going with confidence!!
translation:
*叹息* 怪物不断变强 不过
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]你变强了
还有! 继续满怀信心!

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you've really gotten used to traveling.
I feel like you're more gallant than when we started.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]你真的习惯了旅行
我觉得你比我们开始的时候更勇敢

source:
So...tired...
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], aren't you a little too energetic?
How can you have that much energy with no sleep?
translation:
这么... 累...
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]你是不是有点太激动了?
睡不着怎么有那么多精力?

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you really are superhuman.
The monsters keep getting stronger,
but you've come this far without sleeping...
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]你真的是个超人
怪物不断变强
但你已经走到了这么远 没有睡觉...

source: That's huge... It's penetrating the clouds...
translation: 这么大... 它穿透云层...

source: Can we really beat that thing?
translation: 我们真的能打败那东西吗?

source:
For now, if we get too close
we'll turn to dust...
translation:
现在,如果我们太接近了
我们会变成尘土...

source:
You should use a weapon that can attack from far away.
Spears, bows, guns, or thrown items might be effective.
translation:
你应该用武器从很远的地方攻击
矛、弓、枪或投掷物可能有效。

source:
Little by little...
Damage it as much as you can!
translation:
一点一点...
尽量破坏它!

source:
Wow, you broke that barrier.
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], you're incredible...
translation:
哇,你打破了障碍。
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]你是不可思议的...

source:
Don't miss this chance!
\c[51]Zeukrees\c[0] will rebuild
that fog barrier in a few hours...
translation:
别错过这个机会!
\c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0] 将重建
几小时后雾屏障...

source:
But if we get too close we'll turn to ash.
What should we do...
translation:
但如果我们走得太近,我们就会变成灰烬
我们该怎么办...

source:
Let's see...
There's nothing to do but attack with ranged weapons
like bows, thrown items or use Force Powers.
translation:
让我看看...
没什么事,只用射程武器攻击
像弓,扔东西,或使用 力力强。

source:
Watch out when \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0] starts to
build energy. He's preparing to unleash
a wave of white flame.
translation:
当心 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0] 开始
制造能量。 他准备释放
一股白火

source:
Can you even dodge a blast
from something so colossal?
Maybe you should use a \c[52]Teleport Potion\c[0].
translation:
你还能躲开一阵吗?
从如此巨大的东西?
也许你应该用 \c[52]电传口水\c[0].

source:
Yes.
If you can't avoid it, or if you're not fully prepared
for the flame, muster your defense.
translation:
对
如果你不能避免它, 或者如果你没有完全准备
为了火焰,召集你的防御。

source:
Right. We know the plan!
Somehow, I'm beginning to think we just might make it!!
translation:
对 我们知道计划!
不知怎的,我开始觉得我们可能会成功!

source:
It's really scary,
but complaining won't change anything...
translation:
真吓人
但抱怨不会改变任何事...

source:
Okay! \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! \c[51]Alma\c[0]!
Let's take down the Shine Raid...
Let's take down \c[51]Zeukrees\c[0]!!
translation:
来啊! \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! \c[51]阿尔马\c[0]!
让我们拿下神电击...
让我们拿下来 \c[51]泽克赖斯\c[0]!!
1 小时至 \c[51]冥王星\c[0] 不见了!

source:
\>You sense the "Wiseman" ahead.
Do you have the \c[52]Dream Stones\c[0]?
translation:
\>你感觉到前面的"威斯曼"了
你有吗? \c[52]梦之石\c[0]?

source:
\>You sense the "Wiseman" ahead.
Ready for the Corridor of Dreams?
translation:
\>你感觉到前面的"威斯曼"了
准备好去梦幻走廊了吗?

source:
\c[51]The Fallen Angel\c[0] will appear in
...3 hours!
translation:
\c[51]堕落天使\c[0] 将出现在
...3 数小时!

\c[51]冥王星\c[0] 将出现在
...3 数小时!

source: The area fills with a miasma...
translation: 这片区域充满了米拉斯马...

source: You can sense a ghostly presence...
translation: 你能感觉到鬼魂的存在...
突然好冷啊 突然间...

感觉很危险...
小心点

source:
Keyton wants to chat.
You should talk to him soon.
translation:
凯顿想和你谈谈
你应该尽快和他谈谈

source:
Nami wants to chat.
You should talk to her soon.
translation:
娜美想和你谈谈
你应该尽快跟她谈谈

source:
Cole wants to chat.
You should talk to him soon.
translation:
科尔想聊天。
你应该尽快和他谈谈

source:
Draco wants to chat.
You should talk to him soon.
translation:
德拉科想谈谈
你应该尽快和他谈谈

source:
Merril wants to chat.
You should talk to her soon.
translation:
梅瑞尔想和你谈谈
你应该尽快跟她谈谈

source:
Baldur wants to chat.
You should talk to him soon.
translation:
巴尔杜尔想聊聊
你应该尽快和他谈谈

source:
Aerdou wants to chat.
You should talk to him soon.
translation:
艾尔杜想和你谈谈
你应该尽快和他谈谈

source:
Coco & Muddy want to chat.
You should talk to them soon.
translation:
Coco & Muddy 想要聊天 。
你应该尽快和他们谈谈

source:
Dosey wants to chat.
You should talk to her soon.
translation:
多西想谈谈。
你应该尽快跟她谈谈

source:
Olga wants to chat.
You should talk to her soon.
translation:
奥尔加想要聊天。
你应该尽快跟她谈谈

source:
Alma wants to chat.
You should talk to her soon.
translation:
阿尔玛想聊聊
你应该尽快跟她谈谈

source: Time for the Demon Lord to return...

Huu... Later then,
hero of this world.
translation:
霍... 乌... 等会儿
这个世界的英雄

source:
The Demon Lord said only that
and left this world.
translation:
恶魔主只说
离开了这个世界

source:
I wonder if he returned to
the world where he belongs?
translation:
不知道他会不会回来
他属于的世界?

source:
The contract with the summoned
beast has expired...
translation:
与被传唤者的合同
野兽已经过期了...

source:
The summoned beast has returned
to the world where it belongs...
translation:
被召唤的野兽回来了
属于它的世界...

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! A messenger raven!!
Is that the royal seal?! It's from a friend.
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! 信使乌鸦!
那是皇室封印吗? 这是朋友送的

source: Alrighty, you did a good little job.
translation: 好吧,你做了一个好小工作。

source:
What's it say?
"\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0], it seems you've safely begun
your journey to defeat the Fallen Angel"
translation:
上面写什么?
"\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]似乎你已经安全地开始了
你打败堕落天使的旅程

source:
"According to the information we have... The Fallen
Angel is currently \c[52]400 km\c[0] east of Konrath's
Castle. Please be prepared to fight by that point."
translation:
"根据我们掌握的信息... 堕落者
天使现在 \c[52]400 公里数\c[0] 康拉斯东区
卡塞尔 请准备在这一点上战斗。"

source:
So, at \c[52]400 km\c[0].
Let's make sure we're prepared!
translation:
所以,在 \c[52]400 公里数\c[0].
让我们确保我们准备好了!

source:
We've finally made it halfway to our destination.
I'm getting excited...
translation:
我们终于到目的地了
我越来越兴奋了...

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! Are you ready?
The final battle is coming!
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! 你准备好了吗?
决战即将来临!

source:
We're almost at our destination...
I'm getting really nervous.
translation:
我们快到目的地了...
我变得非常紧张。

source: And there's another messenger raven! Let's see...
translation: 还有另一个信差乌鸦! 让我看看...

source:
"If you have progressed smoothly, I believe you should
nearly be in the area of the battle for the fate
of the world."
translation:
"如果你进展顺利, 我相信你应该
几乎在为命运而战的地方
这个世界。"

source:
"We have sent our most skilled allies as reinforcements.
I believe they should arrive before the battle begins..."
translation:
"我们派出了最熟练的盟友作为援军
我相信他们应该在战争开始前到达..."

source:
"But if they don't happen to make it, then... please
endure somehow."
...is what it says.
translation:
"但是如果他们不碰巧做到了,那么..." 请
以某种方式忍受。"
上面写着

source:
Reinforcements!
That's great.
I hope they make it here before the final battle...
translation:
援军!
这是伟大的。
我希望他们在决战前能赶到这里...

source:
Nngh, such power.
That sure is the Fallen Angel trying to destroy
the world.
translation:
这么厉害啊
那肯定是堕落天使想要摧毁的
这个世界。

source:
But if we retreat now,
the world will be swallowed in light...
translation:
但是如果我们现在撤退
世界将被光吞噬...

好样的!
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! 让我们做到这一点!

source:
I'm sure the reinforcements will be here any minute.
Until then... we have to endure the Fallen Angel's
attacks somehow.
translation:
我敢肯定,援军 将在这里的任何一分钟。
直到那时... 我们必须忍受堕落天使
以某种方式攻击。

source:
The reinforcements aren't coming...
What happened?
But... we can't lose!!
translation:
援军不会来了...
发生什么事了?
不过... 我们不能输!

source:
Sorry to keep you waiting, hero and
fairy! We won't let you have this fight
to yourselves!
translation:
抱歉让你久等了,英雄
仙女们! 我们不会让你打这仗的
为你们自己!

source:
Sorry we're late. Now, let's take down
the Fallen Angel together!!
translation:
对不起,我们迟到了。 现在,我们开始吧
堕落天使在一起!

source:
\c[52]Allies have joined!\c[0]
When enemies are close, they'll
attack while protecting your back!
translation:
\c[52]盟军已经加入!\c[0]
当敌人接近时,他们会
攻击的同时保护你的背部!

source:
Huh? This is...
There's a ton of energy gathered here.
translation:
是吗? 这是...
这里聚集了一大堆能量

source:
Um? Normally you can only ask a \c[51]Save Elf\c[0]
or use \c[52]Memory Gems\c[0] to \c[52]Save\c[0],
but if it's a place with this much energy...
translation:
嗯？ 通常你只能问 \c[51]保存精灵\c[0]
使用 \c[52]内存宝石\c[0] 页:1 \c[52]保存\c[0],
但如果这里有这么大的能量...

source:
Even I can \c[52]Save\c[0] for you. But it will cost levels,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]. What do you want to do?
[Current Lvl. $tmp1] \c[52][Lvl. Cost 5]
translation:
连我都行 \c[52]保存\c[0] 给你的 但它将花费水平,
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]. 你想怎么办?
[现时Lvl. $tmp1] \c[52][法 费用 5]

source:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! That's mean!
I was nice and let you know...
translation:
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]! 这太刻薄了!
我挺好的,让你知道...

source:
Well that's just fine!
Next time I find one I won't tell you, \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!
translation:
这很好!
下次我找到一个 我不会告诉你的 \c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0]!

source:
Okay! Now put your hand over that
and build up your strength!
translation:
来啊! 现在把你的手拿过来
并增强你的力量!

额... Haaahaaaa...
这... 这个...

source:
That makes you pretty tired.
Those \c[51]Save Elves\c[0] are amazing.
translation:
这让你很累。
这些 \c[51]保存精灵\c[0] 这是惊人的。

\>已经用完 5 关卡!
(利比里亚) $tmp1 > $tmp2)

source:
It looks like your level is too low...
Ah well, let's give up for now, okay?
translation:
看来你的水平太低了
好了,让我们暂时放弃,好吗?

source: \>I can see the "End of the East"...!

The view up ahead is different. The
trees are dried up, houses are ruined.
It's a wasteland, but it seems familiar.
translation:
前面的风景不同 缩略语
树木干涸,房屋被毁。
这是一个荒地,但它似乎熟悉。

source:
White ash is falling. There are no
signs of life in the castle up ahead.
But there's no mistaking it.
translation:
白灰正在坠落。 没有
前面的城堡里有生命的迹象
但是没有错

source:
It seems while you were traveling,
you circumnavigated the world.
This is the "End of the East"...
translation:
似乎当你旅行的时候
你环绕世界。
这是"东方末日"
这不是结束。_\c[52]又一个_1000公里数\c[0]

source:
Right, this isn't the end...
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] will continue!
translation:
对了,这不是结束...
\c[50]<PLAYER>\c[0] 将继续下去!

source:
<PLAYER> finally arrived
at the "End of the East"!
translation:
